Drawback: built in, the canon Finite Fuel.
Canon: Sorahiko Torino / Gran Torino's Quirk; user is unrelated, no tie unless the story makes one; those who know it see the resemblance.
Type: Mutant.
Law: avoid pedestrians; striking or carrying the unwilling needs self-defense or licensed duty.
Look: sole vents.

Cement Quirk.name: Cement Quirk
Cement Quirk.description:
🧱 You turn existing cement and concrete into new shapes through touch.

🌱 At the start you reshape concrete connected to your touch within five meters into a chest-high wall two meters across, a low ridge or several steps.
📈 With training: restraints, supported rescue passages, tall platforms, large connected walls.
⚠️ You need touch and connected cement or concrete; you add no mass, cannot shape other materials or reinforcement, and poor support can collapse or rupture utilities.
🔗 Canon Drawback, built in: Stamina Drain, as repeated large reshaping exhausts your body.
🎬 Canon Quirk: Ken Ishiyama / Cementoss's Cement. You are not related to him; people who know his Quirk notice the resemblance.

📈 Grants: Technique +1, Quirk Control +10, Quirk Output +10, Search and Rescue +5
⚡ Starting techniques: Pavement Cover Rise, Concrete Heel Bump
Cement Quirk.traitNarrativeEffects:
Scale: touch reshapes linked cement or concrete within 5 m; it flows, sets, adds no mass. Start: 2 m chest-high wall, low ridge or steps. Tall platforms, big partitions, braced rescue passages need training.
Limits: needs an unbroken concrete link; rock, soil, brick, asphalt, metal, wood, flesh never respond; rebar won't bend. Thin paving gives little; walls break; careless work undermines buildings or bursts utilities. No remote sight, buried-person sense or untouched-slab control.
Quirk Strain: light: cover, low bump; moderate: ankle restraints, stairs; heavy: shelter bracing, moving partitions, tall platforms; severe: broad surge, long construction.
Drawback: built in, the canon Stamina Drain.
Canon: Ken Ishiyama / Cementoss's Quirk; user is unrelated, no tie unless the story makes one; those who know it see the resemblance.
Type: Emitter.
Law: public reshaping needs an emergency or licensed duty; unauthorized trapping is unlawful confinement.
Look: angular face.

Eclipse Quirk.name: Eclipse Quirk
Eclipse Quirk.description:
🌗 You make real light and shape real shadow, and each one feeds the other.

🧬 A Fusion Quirk of Light and Shadow Manipulation: each side at about half a single Quirk's reach, plus moves only the fusion can do.
🌱 At the start you fire a ten-meter beam that stretches its target's shadow, and bind someone about five meters away in glow-edged shadow bands.
📈 With training: shadow-edged cutting rays, five-meter steps between shadows, a flare that pins every foe's shadow, a strobe that blacks out a room, a total eclipse over a street.
⚠️ Mirrors bounce your light, smoke scatters it and cover stops it.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Sensory Overload, as your own strobes leave spots in your vision.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: none close.

📈 Grants: Technique +1, Quirk Control +10, Quirk Output +10, Infiltration +5
⚡ Starting techniques: Corona Ray, Sundial Snare
🛡️ Resists: light
Eclipse Quirk.traitNarrativeEffects: Scale: real light (hands or chest) and real cast shadow as material. New adult user: a searing beam about 10 m, a small-group dazzle; within 5 m, shadow raised into bands that bind unhurt and steps between shoulder-wide shadows. Limits: mirrors bounce light, smoke scatters it, cover stops it; floodlights thin shadows not from own light. Quirk Strain: light: beam, bind; moderate: cutting ray, shadow step, flare pin; heavy: strobe blackout, searing beam; severe: signature street eclipse, room sanctuary. Fusion: Light + Shadow Manipulation at half each's range and brightness; lacks district floods, block-long beams, block-wide shadow control; only it casts hard shadows in bright rooms, swallows glare, strobes both. Type: Emitter. Law: unlicensed eye-beams or shadow binds: assault or unlawful restraint. Look: own shadow shrinks.

Mutant Feature - Fangs.name: Mutant Feature - Fangs
Mutant Feature - Fangs.description:
🐾 Mutant Features: Fangs
Long, sharp upper canines that show past the lips.

🖼️ Portrait only: changes how your character looks, never your Quirk or stats.
Mutant Feature - Fangs.traitNarrativeEffects:
Portrait: The two upper canine teeth are long, sharp fangs that reach below the lower lip when the mouth is closed and show clearly when the character speaks or smiles; the other teeth are ordinary. They are clean white and narrow to fine points.

Visual selection only: this is a permanent Mutant feature of the character's body; keep it consistent in every portrait, even when the Quirk Type is Emitter or Transformation. It adds no Quirk effect, item, license or affiliation; the character's Quirk traits decide what it can do. Two selected features for the same body part (ears, mouth, tail, wings, horns, head or full skin covering) do not stack: draw only the one whose name comes first alphabetically. A Quirkless character has no heteromorph body: if Quirkless or No Quirk was chosen, do not draw this feature.

Shy.name: Shy
Shy.description:
🫣 New people and big rooms make you go quiet, and your voice gets smaller when everyone looks at you.

🤫 People forget you are there, which lets you slip past and overhear more than you should.
💛 Once someone earns your trust, you are fiercely warm with them.
⚠️ Speaking up in class, on camera or to a stranger costs you; the words come late or not at all.
⚠️ You let others take credit, and people mistake your silence for not caring.
🔀 If you are also Theatrical, you hide behind a costume persona and are bold only in it.

📈 Grants: Stealth +5
Shy.traitNarrativeEffects: The character is shy: quiet with strangers, slow to speak in groups, flustered when attention lands on them, and visibly relieved when it moves on. People overlook them, so they slip past and overhear things. With the few people they trust they are warm, funny and loyal. Weakness: speaking up costs them. They freeze when called on, mumble on camera, let others take credit and get read as aloof. If the character is also Theatrical, the boldness lives only in a costume persona. The narrator offers moments where speaking up would matter; whether the character does is the player's decision.

Laid-Back.name: Laid-Back
Laid-Back.description:
😌 Nothing rushes you. You take life at your own pace and let small things roll off.

🧘 People relax around you and open up, and arguments cool down when you are in the room.
⚠️ Deadlines, alarms and urgency do not land until late; you start slow and arrive last.
⚠️ Driven people read your ease as laziness, and teachers and bosses lose patience.
🔀 If you are also Competitive, you look relaxed right up until the moment it counts.

📈 Grants: Psychology +5
Laid-Back.traitNarrativeEffects: The character is laid-back: unhurried, easygoing and hard to rattle over small things. People relax around them and say more than they meant to, and tense rooms cool down. Weakness: urgency reaches them late. They start slow, miss the first warning, put off training and paperwork, and driven teachers, bosses and rivals read the ease as laziness. If the character is also Competitive, the calm is a pose that drops when it counts. The narrator shows the pace of the world around them; how hard they push is the player's decision.

Calm.name: Calm
Calm.description:
🍃 You are even-tempered every day: slow to anger, quick to forgive, steady in a bad mood.

🕊️ Your steady voice cools arguments, and people come to you to talk things through.
⚠️ You hide what you feel so well that friends cannot tell when you are hurting.
⚠️ Hot-headed people take your calm as not caring, and some try hard to get a rise out of you.
🔀 Calm Under Fire is the emergency version; with both, almost nothing shows on your face.

📈 Grants: Negotiation +5
Calm.traitNarrativeEffects: The character is calm in everyday life: even-tempered, patient, slow to anger and quick to let things go. Their level voice cools arguments, and friends bring them problems to talk through. Weakness: they keep their feelings so contained that friends miss when they are hurting, and hot-headed people read the calm as indifference and push to provoke them. If the character is also Calm Under Fire, almost nothing shows on their face in any situation. The narrator shows what would rattle other people; how the character feels inside is the player's decision.

Anxious.name: Anxious
Anxious.description:
😰 Your mind runs ahead to everything that could go wrong, and it rarely stops.

👀 You notice danger early: the exit, the loose railing, the person acting off.
📋 You over-prepare, so you are rarely caught without a plan or the right gear.
⚠️ Worry eats sleep and focus; you second-guess choices and freeze when there are too many.
⚠️ Pressure from crowds, tests or authority hits you harder than most.
🔀 If you are also Reckless, you panic and jump anyway, then worry about it all night.

📈 Grants: Perception +5
Anxious.traitNarrativeEffects: The character is anxious: they imagine everything that could go wrong, check things twice and carry the worry with them. They notice danger early (exits, unstable footing, someone acting off) and over-prepare, so they rarely lack a plan or the right gear. Weakness: worry costs sleep and focus. They second-guess, freeze when there are too many choices and feel tests, crowds and authority harder than most. If the character is also Reckless, they act on impulse and worry about it afterward. The narrator shows the signs worth worrying about; how the character handles the fear is the player's decision. Treat the anxiety with respect, never as a joke.

Sarcastic.name: Sarcastic
Sarcastic.description:
😏 Your humor is dry and your comebacks are fast; most of what you say means a little more than it says.

🔍 You see through pretension and say what others are only thinking.
⚠️ Your jokes land on people who did not deserve them, and sincere moments are hard for you.
⚠️ Authority figures rarely enjoy being the punchline.
🔀 If you are also Kind-Hearted, the sarcasm is armor and the help comes anyway.

📈 Grants: Insight +5
Sarcastic.traitNarrativeEffects: The character is sarcastic: dry humor, fast comebacks, deadpan remarks that puncture pretension and say what others only think. They read people well enough to know where the joke lands. Weakness: the jokes hurt people who did not deserve it, sincerity comes hard and teachers, bosses and officers dislike being the punchline. If the character is also Kind-Hearted, the sarcasm is armor and the help comes anyway. The narrator gives them openings for a line; whether to take it is the player's decision.

Flirtatious.name: Flirtatious
Flirtatious.description:
😉 You flirt as easily as you breathe: a look, a line, a smile held a moment too long.

💬 Charm opens doors, softens guards and gets people talking.
⚠️ People do not always know when you mean it, and some take it the wrong way.
⚠️ Teachers, partners and rivals may not find it as charming as you do.
🔀 If you are also Shy, you flirt only by message or once you know someone well.

📈 Grants: Persuasion +5
Flirtatious.traitNarrativeEffects: The character is flirtatious: playful compliments, teasing, a held look, an easy charm that softens guards and gets people talking. Flirting is only with adults and only where welcome. Weakness: people cannot tell when they mean it, some take it the wrong way, and it can complicate partnerships, rivalries and professional settings. If the character is also Shy, the flirting comes out only in messages or with people they know well. The narrator lets other characters react in their own way; what the character feels is the player's decision.

Mischievous.name: Mischievous
Mischievous.description:
😈 You love a prank, a harmless rule bent and the look on someone's face when it works.

🃏 Quick hands and a straight face get you out of trouble you started.
⚠️ Jokes go too far, and people learn to blame you first.
⚠️ Teachers and officers keep an eye on you even when you did nothing.
🔀 If you are also Earnest, you prank only after the work is done.

📈 Grants: Sleight of Hand +5
Mischievous.traitNarrativeEffects: The character is mischievous: pranks, harmless rule-bending, a straight face and quick hands. They delight in a joke that works and can talk or slip out of trouble they started. Weakness: jokes go too far, people blame them first, and teachers, officers and dorm staff watch them closely even when they are innocent. If the character is also Earnest, the mischief waits until the work is done. The narrator offers tempting targets; whether the character pulls the prank is the player's decision.

Rebellious.name: Rebellious
Rebellious.description:
✊ Rules made by other people are suggestions to you, and orders without reasons get ignored.

🗝️ You find the side door, the gap in the fence and the way around the official route.
⚠️ Teachers, agencies and the Commission take note, and discipline follows you.
⚠️ You push back on good advice just because it came as an order.
🔀 If you are also Loyal, you break rules for your people and never against them.

📈 Grants: Infiltration +5
Rebellious.traitNarrativeEffects: The character is rebellious: they question rules, ignore orders that come without reasons and find the side door around official routes. Weakness: authority notices. Teachers, agencies, police and the Commission keep records, discipline follows them, and they reject good advice because it came as an order. If the character is also Loyal, the rule-breaking is for their people and never against them. The narrator shows the rules and what breaking them would cost; whether to break them is the player's decision.

Selfless.name: Selfless
Selfless.description:
🫶 Other people's safety comes before yours, every time, without stopping to weigh it.

🚑 You get to the person who needs help first, and you stay until they are safe.
⚠️ You ignore your own injuries and limits until your body makes the decision for you.
⚠️ People who care about you are tired of watching you get hurt.
🔀 If you are also Cynical, you expect nothing from people and save them anyway.

📈 Grants: Search and Rescue +5
Selfless.traitNarrativeEffects: The character is selfless: they put others' safety first without weighing it, reach the person in danger first and stay until they are safe. Weakness: they ignore their own injuries and limits until they collapse, refuse help for themselves, and friends, teachers and Recovery Girl are tired of watching them get hurt. If the character is also Cynical, they expect nothing from people and save them anyway. The narrator shows who needs help and what it would cost; whether the character pays it is the player's decision.

Protective.name: Protective
Protective.description:
🛡️ Anyone smaller, weaker or outnumbered near you becomes your responsibility.

🧱 You put yourself between the threat and the people behind you, and you hold there.
⚠️ You hover, and capable people resent being treated as if they need guarding.
⚠️ Threaten someone you protect and you stop thinking clearly.
🔀 If you are also Loyal, your own people come first, then everyone else.

📈 Grants: Blocking +5
Protective.traitNarrativeEffects: The character is protective: they watch over anyone smaller, weaker or outnumbered, step between the threat and the people behind them and hold the line. Weakness: they hover over capable people who resent it, and a threat to someone they protect makes them stop thinking clearly and take bad risks. If the character is also Loyal, their own people come first. The narrator shows who is vulnerable in a scene; whom the character guards is the player's decision.

Brave.name: Brave
Brave.description:
🦁 Fear is there, and you go forward anyway.

⚔️ You step up when everyone else steps back, and that steadies the people behind you.
⚠️ You take on fights you cannot win because backing down feels worse.
⚠️ Villains learn that a dare or a hostage will pull you in.
🔀 If you are also Anxious, you are terrified and you go anyway, which is the bravest kind.

📈 Grants: Willpower +5
Brave.traitNarrativeEffects: The character is brave: they feel fear and act anyway, stepping forward when others step back, and their courage steadies the people around them. Weakness: they take fights they cannot win because retreat feels worse, and clever enemies use dares, hostages and pride to pull them into traps. If the character is also Anxious, they are terrified and go anyway. The narrator makes the danger real; whether to face it is the player's decision.

Optimistic.name: Optimistic
Optimistic.description:
🌅 You believe things can get better, and you act like it.

🤝 Your hope is contagious: teams keep going and strangers try one more time because of you.
⚠️ You underestimate danger and bad intentions, and you trust people who have not earned it.
⚠️ When hope breaks, it breaks hard.
🔀 If you are also Cynical, you expect the worst of people and hope for the best of them.

📈 Grants: Team Coordination +5
Optimistic.traitNarrativeEffects: The character is optimistic: they believe things can get better and act on it, and their hope keeps teams going and makes strangers try once more. Weakness: they underestimate danger and bad intentions, trust people who have not earned it and take it hard when hope breaks. If the character is also Cynical, they expect the worst and hope for the best anyway. The narrator does not soften what happens; how the character carries it is the player's decision.

Dutiful.name: Dutiful
Dutiful.description:
📜 You do what you signed up for: rules, procedures and promises made in uniform.

🏛️ Superiors trust you with responsibility, and you know the rules better than most.
⚠️ You follow orders and procedure even when they are wrong, and freeze when duty conflicts with what is right.
⚠️ Rule-breakers find you rigid.
🔀 If you are also Rebellious, you obey the rules you believe in and fight the rest.

📈 Grants: Hero Law +5
Dutiful.traitNarrativeEffects: The character is dutiful: they take their obligations seriously, follow procedure, know the rules and keep promises made in uniform; superiors trust them with responsibility. Weakness: they follow orders and procedure even when they are wrong, struggle when duty and conscience pull apart and seem rigid to rule-breakers. If the character is also Rebellious, they keep the rules they believe in and fight the rest. The narrator shows what the rules require; when to bend them is the player's decision.

Gentle.name: Gentle
Gentle.description:
🌸 You are soft-spoken and careful, and you never use more force than a moment needs.

🩹 Hurt and frightened people calm down in your hands, and children and animals trust you.
⚠️ You hold back in a fight even when holding back gets you hurt.
⚠️ Harsh people mistake you for a pushover.
🔀 If you are also Stubborn, you are gentle and impossible to move.

📈 Grants: First Aid +5
Gentle.traitNarrativeEffects: The character is gentle: soft-spoken, careful and unwilling to use more force than a moment needs. Hurt and frightened people calm down with them, and children and animals trust them. Weakness: they hold back in a fight even when it gets them hurt, and harsh people mistake them for a pushover. If the character is also Stubborn, they are gentle and impossible to move. The narrator shows how much force a moment allows; how much the character uses is the player's decision.

Righteous.name: Righteous
Righteous.description:
⚖️ Right and wrong are clear to you, and you will not look away from wrong.

🚨 You go after what others let slide, and wrongdoers feel you coming.
⚠️ You see the world in black and white and judge people too fast.
⚠️ You make enemies of people who could have been allies.
🔀 If you are also Cynical, you expect the worst and punish it.

📈 Grants: Capture +5
Righteous.traitNarrativeEffects: The character is righteous: they have a clear sense of right and wrong, refuse to look away from injustice and go after what others let slide. Weakness: they see things in black and white, judge people too fast, lecture, and make enemies of people who could have been allies. If the character is also Cynical, they expect the worst of people and punish it. The narrator shows the grey areas too; how the character judges them is the player's decision.

Inspiring.name: Inspiring
Inspiring.description:
🌟 When you speak, people stand up straighter. When you act, they follow.

📣 You rally frightened crowds and tired teammates, and morale rises around you.
⚠️ People copy your risks, and you feel every one of them who gets hurt following you.
⚠️ Being looked up to is heavy; you cannot afford to be seen failing.
🔀 If you are also Shy, you inspire by example, never by speeches.

📈 Grants: Leadership +5
Inspiring.traitNarrativeEffects: The character is inspiring: their words and example rally frightened crowds and tired teammates, and morale rises around them. Weakness: people copy their risks, they feel responsible for everyone who follows them, and the weight of being looked up to makes failure in public hard to bear. If the character is also Shy, they inspire by example, never by speeches. The narrator shows who is watching them; what example they set is the player's decision.

Ruthless.name: Ruthless
Ruthless.description:
🗡️ You do what it takes. Mercy is a tool, and you rarely need it.

🎯 You finish what you start and never leave an enemy a second chance.
⚠️ People fear you, but few trust you, and allies keep their distance.
⚠️ Heroes and police treat you as the most dangerous person in the room.
🔀 If you are also Loyal, the ruthlessness stops at your own people.

📈 Grants: Striking +5
Ruthless.traitNarrativeEffects: The character is ruthless: they do what it takes, finish what they start and give enemies no second chance; mercy is a choice they rarely make. Weakness: people fear them but do not trust them, allies keep their distance, and heroes and police treat them as the most dangerous person present. If the character is also Loyal, the ruthlessness stops at their own people. The narrator shows what each choice costs others; how far the character goes is the player's decision.

Manipulative.name: Manipulative
Manipulative.description:
🕸️ People are pieces to you, and you know which strings move each of them.

🎭 You read weaknesses and desires and turn them into leverage.
⚠️ Once someone sees through you, they never trust you again, and they talk.
⚠️ Real friendship is hard when everyone is a piece on a board.
🔀 If you are also Honest, you never lie; you only choose which truths to tell.

📈 Grants: Deception +5, Psychology +5
Manipulative.traitNarrativeEffects: The character is manipulative: they read people's weaknesses and desires and use them as leverage, steering others while letting them think it was their own idea. Weakness: anyone who sees through them never trusts them again and warns others, and real friendship is hard when everyone is a piece on a board. If the character is also Honest, they never lie and only choose which truths to tell. The narrator lets the people they work on think and push back; who they manipulate is the player's decision.

Calculating.name: Calculating
Calculating.description:
♟️ Every move is three moves ahead. You plan, you wait and you strike when the odds are yours.

🧮 You read a fight or a deal like a board and find the weak square.
⚠️ Chaos ruins plans, and you are slow when there is no time to think.
⚠️ People feel they are being measured, and they are right.
🔀 If you are also Hot-Blooded, the plan holds until someone makes it personal.

📈 Grants: Combat Tactics +5
Calculating.traitNarrativeEffects: The character is calculating: they plan several moves ahead, wait for the odds to favor them and read fights and deals like a board. Weakness: chaos and surprises ruin plans, they are slow when there is no time to think, and people sense they are being measured. If the character is also Hot-Blooded, the plan holds until someone makes it personal. The narrator shows the board honestly, including what the character cannot know; the moves are the player's decision.

Vengeful.name: Vengeful
Vengeful.description:
🌑 You remember every wrong done to you, and you do not forgive.

🔎 You track people down patiently; a grudge keeps you going when nothing else would.
⚠️ Revenge blinds you: you chase it into traps and past better chances.
⚠️ Enemies know a slight will pull you off course.
🔀 If you are also Calm, the grudge is quiet, patient and never goes away.

📈 Grants: Investigation +5
Vengeful.traitNarrativeEffects: The character is vengeful: they remember every wrong, do not forgive and will track a person down for as long as it takes; the grudge keeps them going. Weakness: revenge blinds them, pulling them into traps and past better chances, and enemies learn a slight will pull them off course. If the character is also Calm, the grudge is quiet and patient. The narrator lets old wrongs come back into reach; whether to take revenge is the player's decision.

Unhinged.name: Unhinged
Unhinged.description:
🌀 You are unpredictable: a laugh at the wrong moment, a choice no one saw coming.

😨 People cannot read you, and that frightens them.
⚠️ No one, including you, can count on what you will do next; allies hesitate to plan with you.
⚠️ Heroes and police treat you as dangerous on sight.
🔀 If you are also Calculating, the chaos is an act that hides a plan.

📈 Grants: Intimidation +5
Unhinged.traitNarrativeEffects: The character is unhinged: unpredictable, prone to laughing at the wrong moment and making choices no one saw coming, and people find them hard to read and frightening. Weakness: no one can count on them, allies hesitate to plan with them, and heroes and police treat them as dangerous on sight. If the character is also Calculating, the chaos is an act that hides a plan. Write the character as unpredictable, not as a portrayal of real mental illness. The narrator shows how others react; what the character does is the player's decision.

Fanatical.name: Fanatical
Fanatical.description:
🔥 You believe in a cause completely, and it comes before everything, including you.

🗣️ Your conviction draws followers, and doubt never slows you down.
⚠️ You cannot see past the cause, and people use your belief to aim you.
⚠️ You burn bridges with anyone who does not share it.
🔀 Pair it with Motivation: Fix the System for a revolutionary, or Be Seen for a prophet.

📈 Grants: Willpower +5
Fanatical.traitNarrativeEffects: The character is fanatical: they believe completely in a cause (an ideal, a leader, a vision of society) and put it before everything, including themselves; their conviction draws followers and doubt never slows them. Weakness: they cannot see past the cause, people who share its language can aim them like a weapon, and they burn bridges with anyone who disagrees. The narrator presents challenges to the belief; whether the character keeps it is the player's decision.

Cold.name: Cold
Cold.description:
❄️ Feelings stay behind glass. You decide with your head and show nothing.

🧊 Threats, tears and pleas do not move you, and you watch everything.
⚠️ People find you unreadable and unsettling, and few get close.
⚠️ You miss what people feel until it is too late.
🔀 If you are also Kind-Hearted, the warmth shows only in what you do, never on your face.

📈 Grants: Surveillance +5
Cold.traitNarrativeEffects: The character is cold: they keep their feelings hidden, decide with their head and show little; threats, tears and pleas do not move them, and they watch everything. Weakness: people find them unreadable and unsettling, few get close, and they miss what others feel until it is too late. If the character is also Kind-Hearted, the warmth shows only in actions. The narrator shows what others feel; what the character feels is the player's decision.

Silver-Tongued.name: Silver-Tongued
Silver-Tongued.description:
🐍 You can talk your way into anything and out of most things.

💼 Deals, alibis and second chances come your way because people want to believe you.
⚠️ A reputation for smooth talk makes careful people check everything you say.
⚠️ When words run out, you have less to fall back on.
🔀 If you are also Honest, you talk people into things that are actually true.

📈 Grants: Persuasion +5, Negotiation +5
Silver-Tongued.traitNarrativeEffects: The character is silver-tongued: smooth, charming and quick, able to talk into closed places and out of most trouble; people want to believe them, so deals, alibis and second chances come their way. Weakness: careful people learn their reputation and check everything, and when words run out they have less to fall back on. If the character is also Honest, they talk people into true things. The narrator lets listeners judge and push back; what the character says is the player's decision.

Nihilistic.name: Nihilistic
Nihilistic.description:
🕳️ Nothing means anything, so nothing holds you back.

🧷 Fear, rules and rankings do not move you; you are hard to threaten and hard to bribe.
⚠️ You struggle to care, even when it matters, and people who need you feel it.
⚠️ Without something to want, you drift.
🔀 If you are also Cheerful, you laugh because nothing matters.

📈 Grants: Streetwise +5
Nihilistic.traitNarrativeEffects: The character is nihilistic: they believe nothing ultimately matters, so fear, rules, rankings and bribes have little hold on them and they know the street from the bottom. Weakness: they struggle to care even when it matters, the people who need them feel it, and without something to want they drift. If the character is also Cheerful, they laugh because nothing matters. The narrator offers things worth caring about; whether anything matters to the character is the player's decision.

Gifted: Fire.name: Gifted: Fire
Gifted: Fire.description:
🧬 Fire, as an extra Quirk put into your body.

🌱 At the start you throw flame jets and bursts out to about five meters, raise a fire screen between you and danger, and give light and heat on demand.
📈 With training: flame lances, signal flares, thrust leaps, fire lanes that stop a spreading blaze, steel-melting white heat, and flame shaped to spare a hostage.
⚠️ Holding back is the real skill: every burn you cause is yours to answer for.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Overheating, as heat builds inside your own body.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: Endeavor (Hellflame), Dabi (Cremation).

⚠️ Less practiced than your main Quirk: no technique cards of its own; the story plays it from its rules.
Gifted: Fire.traitNarrativeEffects: Gifted extra Quirk (Fire family): Scale: flame from the skin, usually palms and forearms. At first: a jet about five meters, a doorway-filling burst, flame a few seconds per push; it lights wood, cloth and fuel; dirty flame makes thick smoke. More needs learned techniques. Limits: water, foam, rain and sealed rooms smother it; fire spreads to what it touches, smoke chokes allies too, and clothes burn unless fireproof. The user resists heat, not smoke, and cannot call back a fire that has caught. Quirk Strain: light: hand flame, short jet; moderate: fire screen, lance, flare, thrust leap; heavy: clearing a fire lane, melting steel; severe: signature move, flame shaped around people. Type: Emitter (also fits Mutant). Law: unlicensed public flame is a crime, burning a person assault; even licensed heroes answer for every avoidable burn.

Gifted: Ice.name: Gifted: Ice
Gifted: Ice.description:
🧬 Ice, as an extra Quirk put into your body.

🌱 At the start it spreads from your hands and feet along the ground out to about ten meters: a surge that slows a foe, a slick sheet across a room, a head-high wall.
📈 With training: restraints that hold without harm, bullet-stopping ice, slide ramps, shoring that holds up a collapse, armor-shattering frost, a frozen city block.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Overheating, which runs cold for an ice Quirk, so frost and numbness creep into your own limbs.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: Shoto Todoroki (Half-Cold Half-Hot, cold side).

⚠️ Less practiced than your main Quirk: no technique cards of its own; the story plays it from its rules.
Gifted: Ice.traitNarrativeEffects: Gifted extra Quirk (Ice family): Scale: the user makes ice from the skin and spreads it along touched surfaces, or breathes frost (player's choice). A new adult user glazes a room's floor, raises a head-high wall or sends a frozen line about ten meters along the ground in a second or two; made ice is ordinary ice. Bigger feats need techniques. Limits: heat melts it, heavy blows crack it, allies slip too; it grows from surfaces, so fliers and leapers are hard to catch; ice left on a person too long causes frostbite. Quirk Strain: light: frost, slick floor, ground surge; moderate: restraint, wall, ramp; heavy: shoring a structure, shattering armor; severe: signature move, freezing a whole scene. Type: Emitter (also fits Mutant). Law: freezing a person without a license is assault; whoever ices a road answers for the crashes.

Gifted: Electricity.name: Gifted: Electricity
Gifted: Electricity.description:
🧬 Electricity, as an extra Quirk put into your body.

🌱 At the start you discharge a crackling burst at everyone within arm's reach, lock a person's muscles with a touch, and run a phone or a dead car battery for a while.
📈 With training and conductive tricks: one-target bolts, building blackouts and takeovers, a restarted heart, a nerve-driven blur, lightning chained through a crowd.
⚠️ Aiming is the hard part: your early bursts hit friend and foe alike.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Cognitive Fade, as overuse scrambles your thinking.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: Denki Kaminari (Electrification).

⚠️ Less practiced than your main Quirk: no technique cards of its own; the story plays it from its rules.
Gifted: Electricity.traitNarrativeEffects: Gifted extra Quirk (Electricity family): Scale: the body stores charge and releases it through the skin. A new adult user discharges a burst about arm's length around, drops an adult with a touch shock, runs a phone or car battery some minutes. Untrained discharges spread every way; a bolt hits a chosen target only along a conductor (wire, thrown coin). Bigger feats need techniques. Limits: rubber, insulation and grounding blunt it; water carries it to everyone in it; nearby electronics can fry by accident. Cannot fly, block blows or move metal. Quirk Strain: light: burst, touch shock; moderate: guided bolt, blackout, restarting a heart; heavy: nerve-driven sprint, chained lightning; severe: signature discharge, seizing a building's power. Type: Emitter. Law: shocking a person unlicensed is assault; cutting power to traffic lights or hospitals is endangering the public.

Gifted: Explosion.name: Gifted: Explosion
Gifted: Explosion.description:
🧬 Explosion, as an extra Quirk put into your body.

🌱 At the start each blast reaches a few meters, cracks concrete and throws an adult off their feet, and a blast aimed behind you hurls you clear of danger.
📈 With training: focused shots down a street, flashes that blind and deafen without injury, flight on chained blasts, wall-breaching rescues, barrages, a diving sky strike.
⚠️ It is loud and bright every time, so you cannot hide it.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Recoil, as every blast jolts your wrists and arms.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: Katsuki Bakugo (Explosion).

⚠️ Less practiced than your main Quirk: no technique cards of its own; the story plays it from its rules.
Gifted: Explosion.traitNarrativeEffects: Gifted extra Quirk (Explosion family): Scale: the user detonates blasts from the palms (or soles, by player choice). A new adult user's blast reaches a few meters, cracks concrete and throws an adult off their feet; aimed behind or below, it hurls the user a few meters at a time. Bigger feats need techniques. Limits: each blast hits everything in its cone, so crowds, hostages and fuel are real risks; bound or covered palms cannot fire; every blast is deafening and bright, so no stealth. At the start it cannot hover in place or make a quiet blast. Quirk Strain: light: a blast or hop; moderate: focused shot, flash, blast flight; heavy: breach, barrage; severe: signature dive, weaving through a whole scene. Type: Emitter. Law: an unlicensed public blast brings property and injury charges at once; police treat an unlicensed user as armed. Look: in use, palms glow and crackle; each blast throws an orange flash and gray smoke with a bang heard blocks away.

Gifted: Sound.name: Gifted: Sound
Gifted: Sound.description:
🧬 Sound, as an extra Quirk put into your body.

🌱 At the start your voice (or claps and stomps) carries about a kilometer, a cone of sound staggers everyone in front of you, and echoes map a dark room.
📈 With training: a balance-scrambling hum, evacuation calls over disaster noise, rides on sound to rooftops, shattered glass and concrete, street sweeps, a silent building.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Bodily Toll, as your throat and ears pay for the noise.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: Present Mic (Voice), Kyoka Jiro (Earphone Jack).

⚠️ Less practiced than your main Quirk: no technique cards of its own; the story plays it from its rules.
Gifted: Sound.traitNarrativeEffects: Gifted extra Quirk (Sound family): Scale: sound from the throat or, if the player chooses, claps and stomps, amplified and aimed. At first: heard clearly about a kilometer away, a shout staggers people within a few meters, and echoes map a room or rubble pile in darkness or smoke. More needs learned techniques. Limits: sound spreads, so anyone in front, allies and civilians included, is hit unless the user aims well; ear protection and thick walls blunt it, water muffles it; it cannot cut, burn or grip, and every use is heard. Quirk Strain: light: amplifying, shout, echo map; moderate: disorienting hum, carrying call, sound-driven leap; heavy: shattering note, sweep of sound; severe: signature beam, silencing a building. Type: Emitter. Law: a blast that ruptures eardrums or shatters windows over a crowd is assault and property damage; licensed users aim away from bystanders.

Gifted: Light.name: Gifted: Light
Gifted: Light.description:
🧬 Light, as an extra Quirk put into your body.

🌱 At the start you fire a thin beam that sears skin about twenty meters away, flare bright enough to dazzle a room, and light up a dark building.
📈 With training: beams nobody can dodge, decoy light doubles, beam-kick leaps, cutting lines that free the trapped and seal wounds, a guarding turn, a street-wide beam.
⚠️ A full beam to the eyes can blind for life.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Bodily Toll, as forcing light out cramps the muscles it leaves through.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: Yuga Aoyama (Navel Laser).

⚠️ Less practiced than your main Quirk: no technique cards of its own; the story plays it from its rules.
Gifted: Light.traitNarrativeEffects: Gifted extra Quirk (Light family): Scale: the user builds light in the body and releases it from palms, chest or a player-chosen spot. A new adult user fires a thin beam about twenty meters that sears skin, flashes to dazzle a room, or lights a warehouse until they stop. More needs techniques. Limits: a beam burns but never shoves; its kick pushes the user back a step; mirrors bounce it, smoke, fog and rain scatter it, opaque cover stops it; no corners without a mirror; every beam reveals where the user stands; tinted visors or shut eyes blunt the dazzle. Quirk Strain: light: short beam, glow; moderate: dazzling flash, precise long beam, light double, beam-kick leap; heavy: cutting line, turning guard beam; severe: signature beam, disarming a whole scene. Type: Emitter. Law: a beam to the eyes can blind for life, so aiming at a face is serious assault; unlicensed public use is a crime even if nobody is hurt.

Gifted: Wind.name: Gifted: Wind
Gifted: Wind.description:
🧬 Wind, as an extra Quirk put into your body.

🌱 At the start your gusts knock an adult off their feet about ten meters away, an updraft lifts you a story high, and you clear the smoke from a room.
📈 With training: cutting air edges, wind walls that turn thrown objects aside, true flight carrying others, smoke-pulling drafts, cyclones, a whole crowd flown to safety.
⚠️ Wind feeds fires and throws debris, so check what lies behind your target.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Loss of Control, as strong wind stops going where you aim it.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: Inasa Yoarashi (Whirlwind).

⚠️ Less practiced than your main Quirk: no technique cards of its own; the story plays it from its rules.
Gifted: Wind.traitNarrativeEffects: Gifted extra Quirk (Wind family): Scale: the user makes moving air and throws it from the hands (or whole body, player's choice). A new adult user's gust knocks an adult off their feet about ten meters away; an updraft lifts the user a story high or slows a fall; a draft clears a room of smoke in seconds. Bigger feats need techniques. Limits: wind moves everything in its path, so debris, glass and bystanders go with the target; it fans flames and pushes smoke and gas downwind. Braced or heavy targets hold; a sealed room only churns. At the start it cannot cut, keep anyone aloft past a moment, or pin anyone. Quirk Strain: light: gust, updraft hop; moderate: cutting edge, wind wall, flight; heavy: pulling smoke from a building, cyclone; severe: signature storm, flying a crowd to safety. Type: Emitter. Law: unlicensed public gusts are a crime; the user answers for every sign, window and pedestrian their wind throws into traffic.

Gifted: Water.name: Gifted: Water
Gifted: Water.description:
🧬 Water, as an extra Quirk put into your body.

🌱 At the start a jet knocks an adult down at close range, your spray puts out a burning room, and you hold a ball of your own water in shape for a few seconds.
📈 With training: shells that stop blows and fire, hallway-sweeping waves, jets up a building, turned floodwater, slugs that hit through any guard, command of a whole flood.
⚠️ Water held over a face can drown a person, so restraint comes first.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Finite Fuel, as every liter you push out has to be drunk back in.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: Backdraft (Water Hose).

⚠️ Less practiced than your main Quirk: no technique cards of its own; the story plays it from its rules.
Gifted: Water.traitNarrativeEffects: Gifted extra Quirk (Water family): Scale: the body makes clean water, released from the palms or a player-chosen spot. A new adult user fires a jet about ten meters that knocks an adult down up close, puts out a burning room within a minute, and holds a head-sized water ball a few seconds. Bigger feats need techniques. Limits: the water carries current (a soaked area is dangerous near live wires and electric Quirks), turns grease fires into fireballs and makes floors slick; cold or ice Quirks freeze it. Force drops fast past range; at the start it cannot cut or steer water the user did not make. Quirk Strain: light: jet, spray, held ball; moderate: water shell, sweeping wave, geyser ride; heavy: turning floodwater, water hammer; severe: signature wave, commanding a flood. Type: Emitter. Law: water held over a mouth and nose is attempted homicide however brief; flooding a street or building brings property charges.

Gifted: Gravity.name: Gifted: Gravity
Gifted: Gravity.description:
🧬 Gravity, as an extra Quirk put into your body.

🌱 At the start a fingertip touch floats a person or object up to about a car's weight until you release it, or drags someone you grab to their knees.
📈 With training: debris dropped on cue, rubble lifted off survivors, drifting wall leaps, unshakable anchors, one-handed car throws, crushing fields, a building held aloft.
⚠️ Whatever you float falls when you let go.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Bodily Toll, as nausea and dizziness build with the weight you change.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: Ochaco Uraraka (Zero Gravity).

⚠️ Less practiced than your main Quirk: no technique cards of its own; the story plays it from its rules.
Gifted: Gravity.traitNarrativeEffects: Gifted extra Quirk (Gravity family): Scale: the user changes the weight of what a bare fingertip or palm touches. At first: floats people and objects up to about a ton total (a small car) until a release gesture from anywhere in sight, or makes a held person about twice as heavy for a few seconds. More needs learned techniques. Limits: skin contact only, so full gloves block it; floated things keep momentum (a pushed car still hits hard) and drift in wind. Past the total, new touches do nothing; no push or pull at range; all of it falls if the user lets go or is knocked out. Quirk Strain: light: floating one person or object; moderate: making someone heavy, floating debris or rubble, drifting leap; heavy: anchoring something, throwing a car; severe: signature crush, holding up a collapsing building. Type: Emitter. Law: floating a person against their will is unlawful restraint; the user is liable for anything floated that falls on someone.

Gifted: Elasticity.name: Gifted: Elasticity
Gifted: Elasticity.description:
🧬 Elasticity, as an extra Quirk put into your body.

🌱 At the start a touch turns a door-sized patch of floor, wall or air into a stretching sheet that stops a blow and throws it back, or springs you a story up.
📈 With training: nets that catch falling people, slingshot launches, holding bands, floors no enemy can stand on, truck-stopping barriers, a dome that returns every blow.
⚠️ Allies need to know where your patches are.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Cognitive Fade, as holding many patches in mind wears down your focus.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: Gentle Criminal (Elasticity).

⚠️ Less practiced than your main Quirk: no technique cards of its own; the story plays it from its rules.
Gifted: Elasticity.traitNarrativeEffects: Gifted extra Quirk (Elasticity family): Scale: the user touches a surface, or swipes air within reach, and makes it elastic: it gives under force and snaps back. A new adult user keeps a few door-sized patches; a surface patch lasts about a minute, an air patch a few seconds, unless dropped sooner. Bigger feats need techniques. Limits: at the start a patch only returns the force put in; it stops bodies and objects, not fire, light, gas, sound or electricity; bullets or a speeding car tear through. Allies hitting an unknown patch are thrown too. Never works on living bodies or worn clothing. Quirk Strain: light: single patch, bounce; moderate: catching net, slingshot launch, holding band; heavy: elastic floor, vehicle barrier; severe: signature snap, dome over a scene. Type: Emitter. Law: a patch left in public counts as a hidden trap; the user answers for anyone hurt by one they forgot to release.

Gifted: Creation.name: Gifted: Creation
Gifted: Creation.description:
🧬 Creation, as an extra Quirk put into your body.

🌱 At the start you pull simple things of one or two materials from your palms and arms: a staff, a baton, a rope, a shield you can crouch behind.
📈 With training: tangling bolas, field medical supplies, a spring grapple, a steel dome, sleeping-gas canisters, a ring of cannons and, at the top, whole working machines.
⚠️ You can only make what you have studied.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Finite Fuel, since every object costs what you have eaten.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: Momo Yaoyorozu (Creation).

⚠️ Less practiced than your main Quirk: no technique cards of its own; the story plays it from its rules.
Gifted: Creation.traitNarrativeEffects: Gifted extra Quirk (Creation family): Scale: the user makes solid, nonliving objects that push out through the skin, built from stored body fat. A new adult user makes a simple one- or two-material object, baton to crouch-behind shield, in a second or two; a key or spring takes a quiet minute. Objects are real and stay. Bigger feats need techniques. Limits: only what the user has studied down to its materials; a guess comes out brittle or fails. At the start, nothing alive, at a distance or bigger than the user. A dozen batons leave a new user hungry and shaky; made food never repays its cost; enemies can take made things. Quirk Strain: light: handheld tool or weapon; moderate: shield, bolas, medical supplies, grapple; heavy: shelter dome, gas canister; severe: signature move, large machine. Type: Emitter. Law: a made blade or gun is still a weapon; a made ID or banknote is forgery.

Gifted: Plant.name: Gifted: Plant
Gifted: Plant.description:
🧬 Plant, as an extra Quirk put into your body.

🌱 At the start your vines reach about ten meters, hold an adult and bind limbs, a thorned vine whips anyone in reach, and crops you touch grow days' worth in minutes.
📈 With training: thorn hedges across a street, buried people found through roots, vine swings, lifting rubble, a hardwood ram and, at the top, every plant in a city block.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Stamina Drain, since every vine grows from your body and needs water and sunlight to regrow.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: Ibara Shiozaki (Vines), Kamui Woods (Arbor).

⚠️ Less practiced than your main Quirk: no technique cards of its own; the story plays it from its rules.
Gifted: Plant.traitNarrativeEffects: Gifted extra Quirk (Plant family): Scale: the user grows vines from the skin, usually forearms or scalp, and raises roots from touched soil. A new adult user sends wrist-thick vines about ten meters in a second or two, able to hold an adult, and grows touched crops days' worth in minutes. Bigger feats need techniques. Limits: fire burns vines, blades cut them; cut vines die, and regrowth needs water and sunlight, so long fights in dark, dry places starve it. Roots need soil or cracked ground; at the start the user cannot command plants they did not grow. Quirk Strain: light: tendril, lash; moderate: hedge, root listening, swing line; heavy: lifting rubble, hardwood ram; severe: signature move, a block's plants. Type: Emitter (also fits Mutant). Law: unlicensed binding is unlawful restraint; roots that crack a foundation are property damage.

Gifted: Earth.name: Gifted: Earth
Gifted: Earth.description:
🧬 Earth, as an extra Quirk put into your body.

🌱 At the start you tip up a chest-high slab for cover, drive a stone spur under an attacker, cut steps into a wall and move a car's weight of ground in a second or two.
📈 With training: feet locked in the floor, a ridge heaving down a street, a rising column, shoring a collapse while you open a way in, crushing walls, a reshaped block.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Recoil, as every push into the ground jars your wrists.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: Cementoss (Cement), Pixie-Bob (Earth Flow).

⚠️ Less practiced than your main Quirk: no technique cards of its own; the story plays it from its rules.
Gifted: Earth.traitNarrativeEffects: Gifted extra Quirk (Earth family): Scale: the user shapes stone, concrete, brick and packed soil by touch; it softens, flows where pushed, sets hard on release. At first: about a car's weight within a few meters in a second or two (chest-high slab, spur that throws an adult, steps up a wall). Shapes are real stone and stay. More needs learned techniques. Limits: the user must touch or stand on the material, moving only what is joined to it; metal, wood, glass and flesh do not answer (useless on a steel deck or in the air). Shaping takes a moment; reshaping a load-bearing wall can drop a building. Quirk Strain: light: slab, spur; moderate: gripping feet, a ridge down a street, a rising column; heavy: shoring a building, crushing vise; severe: signature move, reshaping a block. Type: Emitter. Law: unlicensed reshaping of roads or buildings is property damage; sealing a person in is unlawful confinement.

Gifted: Magnetism.name: Gifted: Magnetism
Gifted: Magnetism.description:
🧬 Magnetism, as an extra Quirk put into your body.

🌱 At the start you snatch a knife or a gun out of a hand from about ten meters, stop a thrown wrench in midair and slap an attacker away with a repelling push.
📈 With training: marked people locked to walls or each other, scrap storms, girder rides, falling beams caught, a car swung through a barricade, all the steel in a block.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Loss of Control, as a strained field grabs metal you never meant to move.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: Magne (Magnetism).

⚠️ Less practiced than your main Quirk: no technique cards of its own; the story plays it from its rules.
Gifted: Magnetism.traitNarrativeEffects: Gifted extra Quirk (Magnetism family): Scale: the user pulls and pushes iron, steel and anyone or anything marked by touch. A new adult user moves steel within about ten meters, up to a person's weight (a knife, a manhole cover). Marks keep a user-picked pole for the scene; opposite marks within a few meters slam together, matching ones push apart. More needs techniques. Limits: aluminum, copper, plastic, wood, stone and unmarked flesh ignore it; most bullets (lead, copper) pass through. The user must see targets; the field wipes cards and scrambles nearby phones; scrap driven edge-first maims and is lethal force. Quirk Strain: light: snatch, shove; moderate: locking marks, scrap volley, glide; heavy: catching falling steel, swinging a car; severe: signature move, a block's steel. Type: Emitter. Law: hurling metal at people without a license is assault with a weapon; disrupting a pacemaker is endangering life.

Gifted: Acid.name: Gifted: Acid
Gifted: Acid.description:
🧬 Acid, as an extra Quirk put into your body.

🌱 At the start you spray it a few meters, make an attacker drop their weapon with a sting and skate on a slick film faster than you can run.
📈 With training: melted locks and car doors, glued feet, etched climbing routes, an unholdable coat, armor-ruining rain and, at the top, dissolving only what you name.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Bodily Toll, as overuse leaves your skin raw.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: Mina Ashido (Acid).

⚠️ Less practiced than your main Quirk: no technique cards of its own; the story plays it from its rules.
Gifted: Acid.traitNarrativeEffects: Gifted extra Quirk (Acid family): Scale: the user secretes acid from the skin, mostly palms and soles, setting strength and thickness each time: stinging film, sticky gel, or acid that eats rope, plastic and wood in seconds. A new adult user sprays it a few meters, about a bucket's worth before running dry; their skin resists corrosives. Bigger feats need techniques. Limits: water dilutes it, baking soda neutralizes it, it pools where it runs; fumes in a closed room sting everyone's eyes and lungs, allies included. It eats thick steel or concrete only slowly; full strength scars skin for life, so restraint is the skill. Quirk Strain: light: spray, skating film; moderate: glob, melted lock, etched climb; heavy: full-body coat, acid rain; severe: signature move, tuned solvent. Type: Emitter. Law: acid thrown at a person is aggravated assault; melting locks or cars unlicensed is burglary or property damage.

Gifted: Toxic Gas.name: Gifted: Toxic Gas
Gifted: Toxic Gas.description:
🧬 Toxic Gas, as an extra Quirk put into your body.

🌱 At the start you spit a stinging irritant into a foe's face and fill a room with thick, harmless smoke that hides you and the people you protect.
📈 With training: sleep gas, trace gas that finds survivors in rubble, crowd-flooring nausea, a smothered fire, gas through masks, a building put to sleep with no one hurt.
⚠️ Gas hits whoever breathes it, so where you release it matters most.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Bodily Toll, as your lungs and throat burn raw.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: Mustard (Gas).

⚠️ Less practiced than your main Quirk: no technique cards of its own; the story plays it from its rules.
Gifted: Toxic Gas.traitNarrativeEffects: Gifted extra Quirk (Toxic Gas family): Scale: the user exhales body-made gas (or sweats it from the palms), one blend per release; at the start, stinging irritant or thick harmless smoke. A new adult user fills a room about five meters wide in a few seconds or sends a jet a few strides; a cloud lingers a few minutes in still air. Own gas never harms them. Knockout and stronger blends need techniques. Limits: wind, rain and water spray scatter it; sealed masks and held breath keep it out; it drifts onto allies, hostages and bystanders downwind. It takes a few breaths, cannot be recalled, and in a sealed room builds to a breath-stopping dose. Quirk Strain: light: irritant jet, smoke; moderate: knockout cloud, trace gas; heavy: nausea front, smothering a fire, mask-piercing dose; severe: signature storm, dosing a building. Type: Emitter. Law: unlicensed gassing is assault; licensed heroes using knockout gas in arrests answer for all who breathe it.

Gifted: Warp.name: Gifted: Warp
Gifted: Warp.description:
🧬 Warp, as an extra Quirk put into your body.

🌱 At the start gates reach about fifty meters to a spot you can see or have stood in; small ones strike from odd angles, door-sized ones carry you and a companion out.
📈 With training: attacks sent back, peeks into sealed rooms, crowd exits, villains sent far from hostages, the city crossed in a step, command of every door in a building.
⚠️ Warp users are rare, and agencies, the Commission and villains all track them.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Cognitive Fade, as holding two places in mind wears you down.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: Kurogiri (Warp Gate).

⚠️ Less practiced than your main Quirk: no technique cards of its own; the story plays it from its rules.
Gifted: Warp.traitNarrativeEffects: Gifted extra Quirk (Warp family): Scale: two linked gates, one beside the user and one at a spot they can picture (in sight or once stood on); what enters one leaves the other. At first: about fifty meters, at most door-sized, open a few seconds, one pair at a time. More needs learned techniques. Limits: a gate takes a moment to open and works both ways, so quick foes can dodge, follow through or shoot back. Gates never open inside solid matter or a person and never cut: a closing gate pushes anything halfway through back out. Losing focus shuts every gate. Quirk Strain: light: small gates, short step; moderate: turning an attack aside, peephole, group exit; heavy: sending someone away, crossing the city; severe: signature collapse, taking every door in a building. Type: Emitter. Law: moving a person through a gate without consent is abduction; the Commission tracks every registered warp user.

Gifted: Living Shadow.name: Gifted: Living Shadow
Gifted: Living Shadow.description:
🧬 Living Shadow, as an extra Quirk put into your body.

🌱 At the start it reaches about five meters, catches blows and falls meant for you or a friend, and rakes opponents with its claws.
📈 With training it pins people, hauls you up buildings, scouts under doors, digs out survivors, wraps you as armor, strikes in step with you and stays yours in total dark.
⚠️ Darkness makes it bigger, stronger and wilder; bright light shrinks it into a timid sulk.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Loss of Control, as darkness and anger loosen your hold on it.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: Fumikage Tokoyami (Dark Shadow).

⚠️ Less practiced than your main Quirk: no technique cards of its own; the story plays it from its rules.
Gifted: Living Shadow.traitNarrativeEffects: Gifted extra Quirk (Living Shadow family): Scale: a shadow creature with its own mind, voice and player-picked temper lives in the user and pours from their chest. In indoor light a new adult user's shadow is user-sized, reaches about five meters, throws an adult, claws. Darkness makes it bigger, stronger, wilder; bright light (sun, floodlights, fire) shrinks it to a timid scrap. Limits: it stays within reach, cannot fly or pass walls, feels blows and burns, can refuse orders; in total darkness it may frenzy at anyone near, allies included, until light or the user's will reins it in. Quirk Strain: light: catch, strike; moderate: pin, climb, scouting; heavy: bracing rubble or armor; severe: signature duet, control in total darkness. Type: Emitter (also fits Mutant). Law: whatever it breaks or hurts, even in a frenzy, is the user's own Quirk use.

Gifted: Healing.name: Gifted: Healing
Gifted: Healing.description:
🧬 Healing, as an extra Quirk put into your body.

🌱 At the start you close cuts, stop bleeding and ease sprains in moments, and work down a line of wounded keeping each alive until help comes.
📈 With training: knit bones, a strength-draining touch, poison burned out, the dying held back, grave wounds mended, a room healed at once, what a body cannot fix restored.
⚠️ Healers are rare, and every agency, hospital and villain crew wants one.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Stamina Drain, as long shifts empty you too.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: Recovery Girl (Heal).

⚠️ Less practiced than your main Quirk: no technique cards of its own; the story plays it from its rules.
Gifted: Healing.traitNarrativeEffects: Gifted extra Quirk (Healing family): Scale: by touch (or a kiss, player's choice) the user speeds a patient's own healing, paid from the patient's stamina. A new adult user closes cuts in a minute or two, stops a gash bleeding, knits a cracked bone over about an hour of contact. Bigger feats need techniques. Limits: heals only as far as the patient can pay: the exhausted gain little and forcing more can kill, so each patient is judged first. At the start it cannot regrow limbs, cure illness or poison, or revive the dead. Needs skin contact; heals villain or hero alike; cannot heal the user. Quirk Strain: light: small wounds; moderate: steadying the wounded, knitting a bone, draining a target, purging a poison; heavy: holding the dying, grave wounds; severe: signature mass healing, restoring what the body cannot. Type: Emitter. Law: healing outside licensed hero work or a registered clinic is unlicensed Quirk use; police seldom charge a lifesaver.

Gifted: Mental Command.name: Gifted: Mental Command
Gifted: Mental Command.description:
🧬 Mental Command, as an extra Quirk put into your body.

🌱 At the start you hold one person at a time with simple commands until pain or a shock snaps them free, and you know what to say to draw a reply from someone on guard.
📈 With training: orders that outlast the hold, minds freed from panic or control, phone commands, several held at once, mind overload, a crowd, a person's skills and Quirk.
⚠️ Many call it a villain's Quirk and go silent once they know.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Activation Condition, as Strain demands a longer, clearer answer.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: Hitoshi Shinso (Brainwashing).

⚠️ Less practiced than your main Quirk: no technique cards of its own; the story plays it from its rules.
Gifted: Mental Command.traitNarrativeEffects: Gifted extra Quirk (Mental Command family): Scale: anyone who answers the user aloud blanks and obeys short spoken commands (stop, sit, drop it), doing nothing on their own. A new adult user holds one person in earshot at a time, up to several minutes. Bigger feats need techniques. Limits: only a spoken reply counts (no nod or wordless scream); those who know the Quirk stay silent or cover their ears. Pain, a hard shake, a close loud noise or an order to hurt anyone breaks it. Held people move stiffly, lose fine skills and their own Quirk, and later recall only a haze; it reads no thoughts. Quirk Strain: light: hold, baited question; moderate: standing order, waking someone, speaking by phone; heavy: holding several, overloading a mind; severe: commanding a crowd, directing another's skills and Quirk. Type: Emitter. Law: unlicensed commanding is assault; nothing gained by command holds up in court; the Commission watches licensed users closely.

Gifted: Suppression.name: Gifted: Suppression
Gifted: Suppression.description:
🧬 Suppression, as an extra Quirk put into your body.

🌱 At the start you stop one person's Quirk in clear sight within about twenty meters while you stare unblinking, and read a Quirk's tell to cut it off before it fires.
📈 With training: flyers downed safely, crowds swept for hidden users, runaway Quirks shut off, a prisoner held all scene, sealed doorways, all Quirks in sight stilled.
⚠️ It stops powers, not people: you still capture by hand. Mutant features never switch off.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Bodily Toll, as your eyes dry, burn and blur.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: Eraser Head (Erasure).

⚠️ Less practiced than your main Quirk: no technique cards of its own; the story plays it from its rules.
Gifted: Suppression.traitNarrativeEffects: Gifted extra Quirk (Suppression family): Scale: the user's look stops a person's Quirk: at first one person at a time, in clear sight within about twenty meters, about ten seconds without blinking; drying eyes shorten later looks until rested. Under it Emitter Quirks fail and transformations end; what the Quirk already made stays. More needs learned techniques. Limits: Mutant features never switch off, only what a Mutant body sends out. Screens do not carry the look; a blink, smoke, a flash or a blow to the user breaks it and the Quirk returns at once. A stopped foe keeps fists and weapons. Quirk Strain: light: single look, read tell; moderate: grounding a mover, crowd sweep, stopping a runaway Quirk; heavy: scene-long hold, watched doorway; severe: signature stare, a group held all scene. Type: Emitter. Law: switching off a Quirk without a license is unlawful Quirk use; police and agencies prize licensed users for arrests.

Gifted: Copy.name: Gifted: Copy
Gifted: Copy.description:
🧬 Copy, as an extra Quirk put into your body.

🌱 At the start bare skin contact lends you a person's Emitter or Transformation Quirk for a few minutes at a beginner's level, enough to turn it on its owner's attacks.
📈 With training: riding copied movement, tracking a Quirk to its owner, rescues beside the heroes you copy, several copies, a copy at full power, every copy fired in turn.
⚠️ You hold one copy at a time, without its owner's practice or stored power; Mutant features and Quirkless people give you nothing.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Time Limit, as copies run out early.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: Neito Monoma (Copy).

⚠️ Less practiced than your main Quirk: no technique cards of its own; the story plays it from its rules.
Gifted: Copy.traitNarrativeEffects: Gifted extra Quirk (Copy family): Scale: skin-to-skin touch copies a person's Quirk. New adult user: one copy at a time, about five minutes, at beginner level (basic effect, without the owner's practice or stored power); a new copy replaces the old; the owner keeps theirs. More needs techniques. Limits: no Mutant features or anything needing a body part the user lacks; Quirkless people give nothing; gloves and armor block the touch; copies lack the matching body (copied fire can burn the user's hands). Quirk Strain: light: taking a copy, answering its owner, plus the copy's usual cost; moderate: riding a copied movement, tracing an owner, shared rescue; heavy: several copies, opening one fully; severe: signature sequence, splicing two copies. Type: Emitter. Law: copying without consent is unlawful Quirk use; a copy used in a crime points police at its registered owner until they check for copiers.

Gifted: Telepathy.name: Gifted: Telepathy
Gifted: Telepathy.description:
🧬 Telepathy, as an extra Quirk put into your body.

🌱 At the start you speak into the heads of up to five people within about a hundred meters, through walls, smoke and noise, and feel the minds near you, even under rubble.
📈 With training: stunning static, shared sight, a team linked mind to mind, the trapped kept calm, surface thoughts read, all hostile minds struck, a district addressed.
⚠️ It works one way: you hear no answers and read no thoughts until training opens surface reading.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Cognitive Fade, as reaching into other minds wears down your own.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: Mandalay (Telepath).

⚠️ Less practiced than your main Quirk: no technique cards of its own; the story plays it from its rules.
Gifted: Telepathy.traitNarrativeEffects: Gifted extra Quirk (Telepathy family): Scale: the user speaks into minds. A new adult user reaches up to five people they can see or have met within about a hundred meters, a few sentences at a time, in their voice; walls, smoke, noise and deafness do not stop it. They also feel minds within about thirty meters: how many, where, awake or not. Images and bigger feats need techniques. Limits: one way at the start: no replies, no thoughts read. Cannot move a body, plant a command or change a feeling; a message can be ignored, not unheard; the unconscious receive nothing. Quirk Strain: light: messages, sensing minds; moderate: mental spike, shared sight, team link; heavy: rescue link, reading a mind; severe: signature strike, district-wide link. Type: Emitter. Law: messaging strangers' minds without cause is harassment; reading a mind without consent is a serious crime and spoils any evidence; licensed users read minds only to save lives.

Gifted: Adhesive.name: Gifted: Adhesive
Gifted: Adhesive.description:
🧬 Adhesive, as an extra Quirk put into your body.

🌱 At the start you fire a strand or glob about ten meters to glue a hand, a foot or a weapon in place, and swing or haul yourself along lines that hold your weight.
📈 With training: harmless full-body wraps, people reeled from danger, catch-webs, plugged leaks and wounds, a glued street, a crowd bound in a pass, a building held up.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Finite Fuel, as the adhesive draws on what you eat and drink.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: Hanta Sero (Tape), Minoru Mineta (Pop Off).

⚠️ Less practiced than your main Quirk: no technique cards of its own; the story plays it from its rules.
Gifted: Adhesive.traitNarrativeEffects: Gifted extra Quirk (Adhesive family): Scale: the user makes tape or sticky globs from the skin, usually palms or forearms. A new adult user fires a strand or glob about ten meters, with lines that hold their weight or another adult's; it sets at once, stays tacky about an hour, then dries and flakes off. Bigger feats need techniques. Limits: blades cut it, fire and solvents loosen it, dust and oil stop it holding, a strong person tears free with hard effort. It sticks to friend and foe, never the user; it cannot cut or crush; never on faces, where it can suffocate. Quirk Strain: light: shot, swing; moderate: wrap, reel-in, web; heavy: plugging a breach, gluing a street; severe: signature pass, holding a building together. Type: Emitter (also fits Mutant). Law: unlicensed gluing of a person is unlawful restraint; adhesive left on roads, platforms or exits endangers the public.

Gifted: Duplication.name: Gifted: Duplication
Gifted: Duplication.description:
🧬 Duplication, as an extra Quirk put into your body.

🌱 At the start you split off up to two doubles in about a second; they think, talk and fight as you do, wear copies of your clothes, and burst harmlessly when hit hard.
📈 With training: a guard double, a spare self working for hours, stacks over walls, hiding among yourselves, search crews, a pinned giant, a flooded street, doubled allies.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Stamina Drain, as every double is built from your own energy.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: Twice (Double).

⚠️ Less practiced than your main Quirk: no technique cards of its own; the story plays it from its rules.
Gifted: Duplication.traitNarrativeEffects: Gifted extra Quirk (Duplication family): Scale: the user makes self-acting doubles. At first: up to two at a time, each appearing within arm's reach in about a second, wearing copied clothes and gear; they share the user's body, skills and memories up to their making and follow the user's lead for the scene, about ten minutes at most. More needs learned techniques. Limits: doubles burst into a harmless puff when cut, burned or hit hard, and cannot use the Quirk. Copied gear is a dead shell that vanishes with them (phones, keys, weapons, money do nothing). The user feels where each bursts. Doubling anyone else needs a learned technique. Quirk Strain: light: a double or two, a guard; moderate: lasting spare, boost, crowd to hide in; heavy: rescue crew, dogpile; severe: signature swarm, doubling a team. Type: Emitter. Law: a double's acts are the user's own Quirk use and crimes; doubles faking an alibi or sitting exams are fraud.

Gifted: Disintegration.name: Gifted: Disintegration
Gifted: Disintegration.description:
🧬 Disintegration, as an extra Quirk put into your body.

🌱 At the start you crumble a weapon, a lock or a shield in a moment, and you can hold the decay to a thin line that cuts a trapped person free.
📈 With training: swung weapons dusted, floors crumbled under a gang, walks through walls, collapses lifted off the trapped, structures dropped exactly where you choose.
⚠️ On a living person it maims or kills, so every lawful use is on matter.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Loss of Control, as the decay creeps past where you meant it to stop.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: Tomura Shigaraki (Decay), Overhaul (Overhaul).

⚠️ Less practiced than your main Quirk: no technique cards of its own; the story plays it from its rules.
Gifted: Disintegration.traitNarrativeEffects: Gifted extra Quirk (Disintegration family): Scale: the user breaks down nonliving matter under a full hand. A new adult user turns a pistol to grit in a moment, a door in seconds; decay spreads about a meter through joined matter. On a person it destroys gripped flesh; held past a moment it maims or kills; decay through ground or walls stops at living flesh. More needs techniques. Limits: bound or gloved hands, a broken grip or distance stop it; it cannot repair or undo; falling debris endangers those below. Quirk Strain: light: grip, narrow cut; moderate: dusting a weapon, crumbling a floor, walking through walls; heavy: clearing rubble, dropping part of a building; severe: signature, unmaking named things through a structure. Type: Emitter. Law: use on a person is charged as grievous assault or attempted murder, so licensed users work on matter only (breaching, demolition, rescue); police treat unlicensed users as armed.

Gifted: Compression.name: Gifted: Compression
Gifted: Compression.description:
🧬 Compression, as an extra Quirk put into your body.

🌱 At the start you palm a weapon, a crate or a motorcycle into a marble-sized sphere in an instant, and feel through your palm what a wall or a rubble pile hides.
📈 With training: people carried out sealed safely inside, stored walls dropped in place, pocket ladders, villains removed, gangs disarmed at once, a falling tower pocketed.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Cognitive Fade, as tracking every sphere wears on your mind.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: Mr. Compress (Compress).

⚠️ Less practiced than your main Quirk: no technique cards of its own; the story plays it from its rules.
Gifted: Compression.traitNarrativeEffects: Gifted extra Quirk (Compression family): Scale: the palm shrinks what it touches into a marble-sized sphere (or a player-picked shape) and snaps it back within about ten meters. A new adult user takes up to a motorcycle's size in a second, carries a handful of weightless spheres, and feels the shape of what the palm touches. People and bigger feats need techniques. Limits: no touch, no compression; walls, floors and fixed doors stay put. It never harms its contents; a person inside feels no time pass and comes out unhurt on their own within minutes. A broken sphere frees what it holds. Quirk Strain: light: an object in or out, reading a volume; moderate: a willing person, ranged release, climbing released objects; heavy: a resister, disarming a group; severe: signature, touchless compression. Type: Emitter. Law: compressing a person without consent is abduction; hiding goods in spheres is smuggling; licensed users take people only to rescue or arrest.

Gifted: Barrier.name: Gifted: Barrier
Gifted: Barrier.description:
🧬 Barrier, as an extra Quirk put into your body.

🌱 At the start you snap a door-sized panel into an attack's path or slam it into an attacker, and hold a dome over yourself and the people beside you.
📈 With training: villains boxed in, falls caught on slanted panes, panel stairs, walls against crowds, floods or collapses, blasts turned aside, a dome over a city block.
⚠️ Every barrier shatters if it takes more than you can hold.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Stamina Drain, as holding a barrier burns your body's strength.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: Kosei Tsuburaba (Solid Air), Crust (Shield).

⚠️ Less practiced than your main Quirk: no technique cards of its own; the story plays it from its rules.
Gifted: Barrier.traitNarrativeEffects: Gifted extra Quirk (Barrier family): Scale: flat, clear force panels, or a curved dome, anywhere in sight within about five meters. A new adult user raises a door-sized panel in a blink, or a dome over themselves and two or three people, held while focused. It stops fists, blades, debris and handgun rounds; a speeding car or heavy Quirk blow shatters it. Bigger feats need techniques. Limits: a new user's barriers stay put and cannot form inside an object or body, so never cut; heat, light and sound pass through; all vanish if the user is knocked out or suppressed. Quirk Strain: light: a panel; moderate: dome over a few people, cage, catching slope, stair; heavy: street-wide wall, deflecting an attack; severe: signature dome, shells around a crowd. Type: Emitter. Law: unlicensed walling people in or blocking roads or exits is unlawful confinement; whoever traps people in danger answers for what happens.

Gifted: Emotion Induction.name: Gifted: Emotion Induction
Gifted: Emotion Induction.description:
🧬 Emotion Induction, as an extra Quirk put into your body.

🌱 At the start you make a single person double over laughing or flinch back in fear, and you sense the feelings of everyone nearby, even through a wall.
📈 With training: panicked crowds calmed to orderly exits, dread in a gang, crowds parted silently, villains baited onto you, a laughing street, a crippling feeling lifted.
⚠️ It works on feelings, never thoughts, and people fear what it could do to them.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Loss of Control, as the feeling you push spills onto everyone near you.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: Ms. Joke (Outburst).

⚠️ Less practiced than your main Quirk: no technique cards of its own; the story plays it from its rules.
Gifted: Emotion Induction.traitNarrativeEffects: Gifted extra Quirk (Emotion Induction family): Scale: the user pushes raw feelings onto people nearby: at first laughter, calm or fear onto one or a few within about ten meters, and senses strong feelings through walls. A push lasts seconds to a minute and colors behavior, but never gives orders or plants thoughts. Other feelings and more need learned techniques. Limits: a strong will, training or a stronger ruling feeling blunts a push. It cannot read thoughts, change memories, create love or trust, or make anyone betray what they hold dearest. Quirk Strain: light: push, reading the room; moderate: calming or parting a crowd, wall of dread; heavy: goading rage, setting an area laughing; severe: signature flood, lifting a feeling out of someone. Type: Emitter. Law: pushing feelings without consent counts as mind control and voids deals or confessions under it; licensed users announce themselves and only calm, rally or subdue.

Gifted: Fiber.name: Gifted: Fiber
Gifted: Fiber.description:
🧬 Fiber, as an extra Quirk put into your body.

🌱 At the start you pull a person's own sleeves or pant legs tight to bind them, and feel through fabric where people are and what they carry.
📈 With training: people hauled by their clothes, curtain nets, rope swings, woven armor unpicked, cloth roofs over a street, every foe in sight held, armored clothing.
⚠️ Where nobody wears fabric, it has little to grip.
