🔗 Common drawback pairing: Activation Condition, since you must see or touch the fabric you move.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: Best Jeanist (Fiber Master).

⚠️ Less practiced than your main Quirk: no technique cards of its own; the story plays it from its rules.
Gifted: Fiber.traitNarrativeEffects: Gifted extra Quirk (Fiber family): Scale: the user moves fibers touched or seen within about ten meters: thread, cloth, rope, felt, carpet. A new adult user grips clothing with a firm hand's strength (enough to pin arms or lock legs), spins cloth into a line that holds an adult, and feels through fabric where it is worn or weighted. More needs techniques. Limits: never hair, skin, wire, leather or rubber, so swimwear or hard armor gives little hold; blades cut threads, fire burns them, strong people tear free; cloth tight at the throat can choke, so trained users never bind there. Quirk Strain: light: binding a person, reading cloth; moderate: hauling someone clear, net, swing line; heavy: unweaving a room's woven guards, weaving a canopy; severe: signature hold, hardening a crowd's clothing. Type: Emitter. Law: unlicensed binding by clothing is unlawful restraint; police treat use to rob or trap as assault.

Gifted: Blood.name: Gifted: Blood
Gifted: Blood.description:
🧬 Blood, as an extra Quirk put into your body.

🌱 At the start you work about a cupful at a time within a few meters: needles flicked from a nicked fingertip, a rope that hardens around someone's wrists.
📈 With training: sealed wounds, a marking drop you follow across the city, blood cables to swing on, a bullet-stopping shell, and spilled blood called back.
⚠️ Dried, soaked-in or washed-away blood slips out of your control.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Finite Fuel, as iron and fluids run low.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: Vlad King (Blood Control), Stain (Bloodcurdle).

⚠️ Less practiced than your main Quirk: no technique cards of its own; the story plays it from its rules.
Gifted: Blood.traitNarrativeEffects: Gifted extra Quirk (Blood family): Scale: the user moves their own blood once it leaves the body through small cuts (lancet or existing wound). A new adult user works about a cupful at a time within about five meters and hardens it instantly; hardened blood holds until broken or released. Bigger feats need techniques. Limits: dried, soaked-in or washed-away blood leaves their control; heavy blows break hardened blood. Never anyone else's blood; bound hands that cannot cut stop it. Quirk Strain: light: needles, cuff; moderate: wound seal, tracking drop, lifeline; heavy: shell over people, thorned lash; severe: signature, calling spilled blood back. Type: Emitter. Law: blood used on a person unlicensed is assault with a weapon; blood left at a scene is evidence police can match to the user.

Gifted: Animal Voice.name: Gifted: Animal Voice
Gifted: Animal Voice.description:
🧬 Animal Voice, as an extra Quirk put into your body.

🌱 At the start any animal within shouting distance grasps simple requests and answers in its own terms. Ask an animal a favor, or ask strays what they saw.
📈 With training you calm a dog mid-attack, send crows to scout, follow alley cats along hidden routes, find trapped survivors and call a district's animals to you.
⚠️ Animals are not soldiers: they refuse real danger and never fight to the death for you.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Sensory Overload, as animal voices crowd your hearing.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: Koji Koda (Anivoice).

⚠️ Less practiced than your main Quirk: no technique cards of its own; the story plays it from its rules.
Gifted: Animal Voice.traitNarrativeEffects: Gifted extra Quirk (Animal Voice family): Scale: the user speaks so animals understand and hears what they mean. A new adult user reaches any animal within about fifty meters, talks to a few at once and makes simple requests (come, follow, look, fetch, warn me). Answers come in smells, sizes, colors, noise and fear, never names or written words. Bigger feats need techniques. Limits: it asks, not commands. Animals refuse fire, gunfire and fights, flee when hurt, forget long tasks; police dogs obey handlers first; insects grasp only gather and scatter. Never on people: animal-featured heteromorphs hear plain speech; treating them as animals insults them. Quirk Strain: light: talk, asking what they saw; moderate: calming, sending scouts, an alley guide; heavy: rubble search, setting a flock on people; severe: signature call, district-wide watch. Type: Emitter. Law: a crime done through an animal is the user's; sending animals into harm brings animal-welfare charges.

Gifted: Hardening.name: Gifted: Hardening
Gifted: Hardening.description:
🧬 Hardening, as an extra Quirk put into your body.

🌱 At the start your whole body hardens in an instant: fists, knives, bats and falling debris stop at your skin, and your hardened fists dent a car door.
📈 With training: diving over people in danger, breaking walls, dropping through floors to the trapped, holding up a ceiling, armor-cracking blows, a past-your-limit strike.
⚠️ It stops cuts and blows, not heat, cold, electricity, gas or sound.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Time Limit, as the hardening softens sooner the harder you push.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: Eijiro Kirishima (Hardening), Tetsutetsu Tetsutetsu (Steel).

⚠️ Less practiced than your main Quirk: no technique cards of its own; the story plays it from its rules.
Gifted: Hardening.traitNarrativeEffects: Gifted extra Quirk (Hardening family): Scale: skin hardens rough and ridged, one limb or the whole body, instantly. A new adult user shrugs off fists, knives, bats and a fall of a story or two, and dents a car door; a pistol round only chips it and bruises. Bigger feats need techniques. Limits: stops cuts and blows, not heat, cold, electricity, gas or sound; a rifle round, a speeding car or a full-power strength Quirk cracks it. Hardened, the user is heavy, sinks and loses fine touch; ridges cut anyone they grab. Quirk Strain: light: one limb, quick full-body flash; moderate: charge, covering a person, hardened drop; heavy: bracing a collapse, armor-breaking flurry; severe: signature move, sheltering a crowd all scene. Type: Transformation. Law: hardening in self-defense is lawful, but a ridged fist outside licensed work is assault, its cuts hard to deny.

Gifted: Size Change.name: Gifted: Size Change
Gifted: Size Change.description:
🧬 Size Change, as an extra Quirk put into your body.

🌱 At the start your hands, forearms or feet swell to car-door size in a second, enough to swat a person flat, hold someone in a palm or shelter people under a cupped hand.
📈 With training: double height, a block in a few strides, apartment-building height for a minute, stomps that topple enemies, a falling bus caught with all inside unhurt.
⚠️ Growth adds strength, not toughness, and you pay for what giant steps break.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Stamina Drain, as extra mass burns your energy.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: Mount Lady (Gigantification), Itsuka Kendo (Big Fist).

⚠️ Less practiced than your main Quirk: no technique cards of its own; the story plays it from its rules.
Gifted: Size Change.traitNarrativeEffects: Gifted extra Quirk (Size Change family): Scale: the user grows their own body or parts of it, gaining strength and weight in proportion. A new adult user swells hands, forearms or feet to about car-door size in a second, holding several minutes; whole-body growth needs techniques, and giant height lasts about a minute at first. Limits: strength, not toughness: bullets and blades still wound a bigger target. No shrinking below normal; nothing grows but the user's body. Grown hands fumble fine work; a grown body cannot fit through doors, cracks floors and roads, and can crush people with a careless step. Quirk Strain: light: hands or feet; moderate: grip, doubled height, long stride; heavy: apartment-building height, giant stomp; severe: signature drop, careful giant rescue. Type: Transformation. Law: unlicensed public growth is an offense; every car, pipe and window a giant form breaks goes on the user's record and bill.

Gifted: Beast Form.name: Gifted: Beast Form
Gifted: Beast Form.description:
🧬 Beast Form, as an extra Quirk put into your body.

🌱 At the start claws come in an instant and the full form in seconds: the size of a large bear, strong enough to push a car aside, with senses far past any person's.
📈 With training: tracking by scent, pinning a villain under your weight, bounding up buildings with people, sheltering people under you, a freezing roar, house size.
⚠️ Pain, fear and anger pull you toward instinct.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Loss of Control, as the beast pushes back under stress.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: Ryukyu (Dragon), Jurota Shishida (Beast).

⚠️ Less practiced than your main Quirk: no technique cards of its own; the story plays it from its rules.
Gifted: Beast Form.traitNarrativeEffects: Gifted extra Quirk (Beast Form family): Scale: the user changes into one beast form picked at creation (bear, big cat, wolf, boar, dragon) and back. At first: claws at once, full form in seconds, about large-bear size, pushes a car aside, tracks a fresh scent across several blocks, held about ten minutes; wings only glide. More needs learned techniques. Limits: the hide turns fists and knives, not bullets. The form cannot use tools, fit through doors or say more than a few rough words; strong smells and loud noise overwhelm it. Pain, fear and rage pull the user toward instinct; clothes tear. Quirk Strain: light: claws, sharper senses; moderate: full form, tracking, a pounce, a climb; heavy: sheltering people, a roar, a long fight; severe: the rampage, the greater form. Type: Transformation. Law: the full form in public draws police at once; an unlicensed claw or bite wound counts as assault with a weapon.

Gifted: Body Blades.name: Gifted: Body Blades
Gifted: Body Blades.description:
🧬 Body Blades, as an extra Quirk put into your body.

🌱 At the start a curved edge about thirty centimeters long slides from your forearms, shins or knuckles in under a second, cutting rope, cloth, wood and plastic.
✂️ It frees a tied-up person in a single stroke, and you strike with the flat when you hold back.
📈 With training: caught weapons, people pinned by their clothes, blade-spur climbs, people cut from wrecks, cleaved armor, a bloom of edges, a room disarmed bloodlessly.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Bodily Toll, as every blade tears its way out through your skin.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: Togaru Kamakiri (Blades).

⚠️ Less practiced than your main Quirk: no technique cards of its own; the story plays it from its rules.
Gifted: Body Blades.traitNarrativeEffects: Gifted extra Quirk (Body Blades family): Scale: the user grows bone-hard blades through the skin of forearms, shins, knuckles and elbows. A new adult user extends an edge of about thirty centimeters in under a second and holds it at will; it cuts rope, cloth, plastic and wood but only scratches steel. More needs techniques. Limits: reach is arm's length plus the blade; blades cannot be thrown or stop bullets. A heavy blow or twisting grip snaps a blade, which bleeds and regrows in about a minute; a grapple on the arms shuts them down. Every edge cuts, so holding back means striking with the flat. Quirk Strain: light: a cut, freeing someone; moderate: block, pin, spur climb; heavy: carving a wreck, cleaving armor; severe: signature bloom, a room of precise cuts. Type: Transformation. Law: blades count as a drawn weapon: unlicensed public use brings police; a cut on a person is an armed attack.

Gifted: Mimicry.name: Gifted: Mimicry
Gifted: Mimicry.description:
🧬 Mimicry, as an extra Quirk put into your body.

🌱 At the start you change in a few seconds, matching face, build and voice, and hold the form about ten minutes per hair or drop; your clothes stay your own.
📈 With training: stand-ins for people in danger, fooled scanners, a trusted face for the scared, slipped cuffs, a day as someone else, face flickers, a gang boss replaced.
⚖️ Wearing a face without its owner's consent is a crime.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Time Limit, as each form slips sooner the harder you push.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: Himiko Toga (Transform).

⚠️ Less practiced than your main Quirk: no technique cards of its own; the story plays it from its rules.
Gifted: Mimicry.traitNarrativeEffects: Gifted extra Quirk (Mimicry family): Scale: from a hair or a few drops of blood, a new adult user takes the person's face, build, voice and height (within a head either way) in about three seconds. A hair or drop lasts about ten minutes, a vial of blood about an hour; one form at a time; samples spoil in a day unless chilled. Limits: clothes and gear never change. No copied Quirk, memories or skills; copied wings do not fly. Blood and scent stay the user's own, so a blood test, tracking dog or personal question exposes them; a hard hit briefly slips features back. Quirk Strain: light: quick change; moderate: form held under attack, partial change, ambush, leading people; heavy: smaller form, day-long cover; severe: signature carousel, a leader's place. Type: Transformation. Law: wearing someone's face without consent is impersonation and fraud; taking blood or hair by force is assault; heroes need consent or an authorized undercover operation.

Gifted: Strength Boost.name: Gifted: Strength Boost
Gifted: Strength Boost.description:
🧬 Strength Boost, as an extra Quirk put into your body.

🌱 At the start a boost lasts about a minute: lift about a ton, punch through a cinder-block wall, throw an adult several meters, hold a fallen beam off a trapped person.
📈 With training: steel doors torn open, crushing holds, rooftop leaps, a collapsing ceiling held up, a speeding truck stopped and, at your peak, an overpass lifted.
⚠️ Swollen hands fumble locks, triggers and injured people.
🔗 Common drawback pairings: Stamina Drain or Finite Fuel, as each boost burns your energy or the fuel you carry.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: Rikido Sato (Sugar Rush), Muscular (Muscle Augmentation).

⚠️ Less practiced than your main Quirk: no technique cards of its own; the story plays it from its rules.
Gifted: Strength Boost.traitNarrativeEffects: Gifted extra Quirk (Strength Boost family): Scale: muscles swell on command for strength far past human. A new adult user bulks up in about a second and, for about a minute per boost, lifts about a ton, punches through a cinder-block wall and throws an adult several meters. Bigger feats need techniques. Limits: strength, not toughness: punching steel still breaks knuckles; blades and bullets cut as deep. No added speed; swollen hands fumble locks, triggers and injured people. Range and an early grapple counter it. Quirk Strain: light: boosted blow; moderate: lift, breach, hold, leap; heavy: holding up a structure, stopping a vehicle; severe: signature blow, lifting an overpass. Type: Transformation. Law: a boosted punch can kill, so police treat an unlicensed user who bulks up in a fight as armed; every injury is judged by the force chosen.

Gifted: Speed Boost.name: Gifted: Speed Boost
Gifted: Speed Boost.description:
🧬 Speed Boost, as an extra Quirk put into your body.

🌱 At the start you match city traffic for a few seconds per burst, throw several punches in the time of one and react to a thrown punch before it lands.
📈 With training: weapons snatched in passing, people carried from harm, wall and water runs, a smoky stairwell cleared, a group struck at once, a falling building emptied.
⚠️ Stopping takes about ten meters.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Overheating, as friction and effort build heat in your body.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: Kendo Rappa (Strongarm) for rapid fists; hyper-speed Quirks also turn up among working pros.

⚠️ Less practiced than your main Quirk: no technique cards of its own; the story plays it from its rules.
Gifted: Speed Boost.traitNarrativeEffects: Gifted extra Quirk (Speed Boost family): Scale: the user speeds up their own legs, arms, nerves and reflexes. At first: about sixty kilometers an hour for a few seconds per burst, several punches in the time of one, reacting to a thrown punch. More, and clean stops, need learned techniques. Limits: at full speed braking takes about ten meters and a sharp turn throws them off their feet. Senses lag behind legs, so crowds, stairs, wet floors and darkness cause crashes. Speed adds no weight to a blow except at a run, cannot outrun bullets and gives no flight; friction burns through ordinary soles. Quirk Strain: light: dash, burst of punches; moderate: snatch, rescue carry, wall or water run; heavy: clearing smoke, striking a group; severe: signature strike, emptying a building. Type: Transformation. Law: unlicensed racing through crowds or traffic is reckless endangerment; an injuring high-speed collision is charged as assault.

Gifted: Phasing.name: Gifted: Phasing
Gifted: Phasing.description:
🧬 Phasing, as an extra Quirk put into your body.

🌱 At the start you phase for as long as you can hold a breath: blows, blades and bullets pass through you, and you walk through about a meter of wall.
📈 With training: peeks through walls, counters from inside a guard, rubble searched from within, people carried through walls, reeling foes, a runaway truck phased past.
⚠️ While phased you cannot see, hear or breathe, and you sink through floors if you lose focus.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Sensory Overload, as sight and sound slam back when you turn solid.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: Mirio Togata (Permeation).

⚠️ Less practiced than your main Quirk: no technique cards of its own; the story plays it from its rules.
Gifted: Phasing.traitNarrativeEffects: Gifted extra Quirk (Phasing family): Scale: the user turns intangible with all they wear and carry. New adult user: phased for a held breath, through about a meter of wall; blows, blades, bullets and blasts pass through. Partial phasing and phasing others need techniques. Limits: fully phased, the user cannot see, hear or breathe and moves from memory; losing focus sinks them through the floor. They must turn solid to strike or grab, and enemies wait for that instant; the Quirk shoves them out of matter before they solidify; mind-affecting Quirks still reach them. Quirk Strain: light: letting an attack through; moderate: wall walk, peek, counter, rubble search; heavy: carrying someone, running through enemies; severe: signature strike, phasing a vehicle or slab. Type: Transformation. Law: phasing into a home or vault without a license or warrant is burglary; police suspect registered phasers first after locked-room break-ins. Look: skin ripples, outline faintly translucent.

Gifted: Impact Absorption.name: Gifted: Impact Absorption
Gifted: Impact Absorption.description:
🧬 Impact Absorption, as an extra Quirk put into your body.

🌱 At the start you go soft as a blow lands, taking a punch, a bat swing or a fall from a second-floor window unhurt, then send what you stored back out in one hard blow.
📈 With training: people shielded, a swallowed arm, rooftop bounces, knives and bullets stopped, a room knocked flat, a fight's force returned, a truck stopped.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Stamina Drain, as holding the soft state burns through your body's reserves.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: Fat Gum (Fat Absorption).

⚠️ Less practiced than your main Quirk: no technique cards of its own; the story plays it from its rules.
Gifted: Impact Absorption.traitNarrativeEffects: Gifted extra Quirk (Impact Absorption family): Scale: while active, the body turns soft and dense; a blow that sinks in is stored as force, not felt. A new adult user takes a strong adult's punch, a bat swing or a second-floor fall unhurt, holds it about a minute, releasing it in one contact blow. Bigger feats need techniques. Limits: only blunt force sinks in; blades and bullets still cut at the start; heat, cold, electricity, sound and gas pass through. Grabs, chokes and unseen blows get no help. Stored force cannot be split or thrown; no sprinting or dodging while soft. A growing flush and tremor warn sharp foes the user is loaded. Quirk Strain: light: soak or release a blow; moderate: shield people, hold an attacker, rebound; heavy: catch blades and bullets, shake the ground; severe: signature release, stopping a vehicle dead. Type: Transformation. Law: soaking blows is self-defense; unlicensed release of stored force into a person is assault.

Gifted: Trait Manifestation.name: Gifted: Trait Manifestation
Gifted: Trait Manifestation.description:
🧬 Trait Manifestation, as an extra Quirk put into your body.

🌱 At the start you turn a hand into a crab's claw, stretch fingers into octopus tentacles, or grow another feature from recent meals, one limb in size, for a few minutes.
📈 With training: a shell for you and someone you hold, wings, squid ink, horns through a wall, a steel-shearing claw, all meals in one form, a crowd caught on tentacles.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Finite Fuel, as each feature burns the meal it came from.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: Tamaki Amajiki (Manifest).

⚠️ Less practiced than your main Quirk: no technique cards of its own; the story plays it from its rules.
Gifted: Trait Manifestation.traitNarrativeEffects: Gifted extra Quirk (Trait Manifestation family): Scale: the user grows features of animals, fish, shellfish and plants eaten within about a day: claws, shells, tentacles, wings, horns, ink sacs. A new adult user grows one at a time, sized to one body part (forearm-sized claw, tentacles about two meters, wings that glide but cannot climb), holds it a few minutes and switches in a breath. Bigger feats need techniques. If meals were never stated, assume shrimp and squid. Limits: no meal, no feature; hard use burns a meal within the hour. Features keep their creature's weaknesses (shells crack, tentacles tear). It never copies a Quirk and draws nothing from people. Quirk Strain: light: one small feature; moderate: shell, wings, ink, whole limb; heavy: horns, giant claw; severe: every meal at once, dozens of tentacles. Type: Transformation. Law: a grown claw or horn is Quirk use; using one on a person unlicensed is assault.

Gifted: Animal Heteromorph.name: Gifted: Animal Heteromorph
Gifted: Animal Heteromorph.description:
🧬 Animal Heteromorph, as an extra Quirk put into your body.

🌱 From the start you have its way of moving, its sharpest sense and its natural weapons: claws, teeth, kicks or a tail.
📈 With training: sheer walls climbed with someone on your back, ambushes felt early, people snatched from danger, a room bounced around and struck, every heartbeat nearby.
⚠️ The features are permanent and visible.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Sensory Overload, as senses this sharp punish noise and stench.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: Tsuyu Asui (Frog), Mirko (Rabbit), Hound Dog (Dog).

⚠️ Less practiced than your main Quirk: no technique cards of its own; the story plays it from its rules.
Gifted: Animal Heteromorph.traitNarrativeEffects: Gifted extra Quirk (Animal Heteromorph family): Scale: the user's body carries one player-chosen animal's senses, movement and natural weapons at human size. New adult users: rabbit or frog legs clear a story per bound; a cat lands on its feet from a second floor; gecko hands cling to walls; the keenest sense matches the animal (a dog's nose trails fresh scent a few blocks). Bigger feats need techniques. Limits: only what the animal's body could do; never flight, gills or venom. Weaknesses too: cold slows cold-blooded bodies, keen noses and ears suffer stench and noise, leapers wrestle poorly. Quirk Strain: none for living in the body; light: bound, sense reading; moderate: wall running, instinct, snatch; heavy: full-strength blow, rampage; severe: signature pounce, sensing a whole block. Type: Mutant. Law: features are legal; unlicensed clawing, biting or kicking a person is assault; the user meets open heteromorph prejudice.

Gifted: Wings.name: Gifted: Wings
Gifted: Wings.description:
🧬 Wings, as an extra Quirk put into your body.

🌱 At the start you take off onto rooftops and across rivers, glide down from any height, and beat a gust that pushes people back and clears smoke.
📈 With training: people carried out, scenes read from above, diving strikes, steered feathers, a group sheltered, a street swept in one pass, a burning tower cleared.
⚠️ Rain, wind and low ceilings ground you.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Bodily Toll, as hard flying tears at the muscles of your back.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: Hawks (Fierce Wings).

⚠️ Less practiced than your main Quirk: no technique cards of its own; the story plays it from its rules.
Gifted: Wings.traitNarrativeEffects: Gifted extra Quirk (Wings family): Scale: wings about twice the user's height tip to tip, feathered unless the player chose leathery or insect. At first: a few blocks at a time at about a car's town speed, a rooftop in seconds, gliding down from any height; carrying an adult or long flight needs a learned technique. Limits: indoors, in alleys or under low ceilings, hops and glides only. Rain, wind and cold slow or ground them; a hurt, netted or grabbed wing downs them. Only feathered wings shed and steer feathers, by technique; a suppressing stare drops steered feathers, never the wings. Quirk Strain: wings themselves cost nothing; light: takeoff, gust; moderate: carry, overwatch, dive; heavy: steering feathers, sheltering people; severe: signature pass, clearing a burning tower. Type: Mutant. Law: wings break no law, but unlicensed public flight is unlawful Quirk use and diving on a person is assault.

Gifted: Aquatic.name: Gifted: Aquatic
Gifted: Aquatic.description:
🧬 Aquatic, as an extra Quirk put into your body.

🌱 At the start you breathe underwater, outswim any athlete, hold a breath through smoke and gas on land, and rush through water to a target or a drowning swimmer.
📈 With training: sonar in murky water, groups towed from floods, any grip slipped, tail and body slams, boats stopped dead, breaches onto a target, rescues held underwater.
⚠️ Dry air and heat wear on you.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Overheating, as exertion out of water heats and dries your body.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: Gang Orca (Orca), Tsuyu Asui (Frog).

⚠️ Less practiced than your main Quirk: no technique cards of its own; the story plays it from its rules.
Gifted: Aquatic.traitNarrativeEffects: Gifted extra Quirk (Aquatic family): Scale: a body built for water: gills, fins, webbed hands and feet or slick skin (player's choice). New adult user: breathes underwater, swims several times faster than a human champion, dives to about thirty meters, sees in murky water and holds a breath on land for minutes. More needs techniques. Limits: ordinary pace on land; dry air and heat dry skin and gills: hours from water tire them until wet again; hot rooms exhaust them; they move through water, never move it; polluted water harms them as anyone. Quirk Strain: living in the body costs nothing; light: dash, held breath; moderate: sonar, towing, slipping a hold; heavy: body slam, ramming a vessel; severe: signature breach, whole-district rescue. Type: Mutant. Law: the features break no law, but holding a person under water is attempted murder, whatever the intent.

Gifted: Extra Limbs.name: Gifted: Extra Limbs
Gifted: Extra Limbs.description:
🧬 Extra Limbs, as an extra Quirk put into your body.

🌱 Each starts about as strong as an ordinary arm: climb, carry and fight with all at once, strike from angles one guard cannot cover, and pin a person with your hands free.
📈 With training: several injured carried, an eye or ear budded at a limb tip, sprints up walls, a falling ceiling held, a group seized, limbs split among separate tasks.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Bodily Toll, as muscle tears where the limbs join.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: Mezo Shoji (Dupli-Arms).

⚠️ Less practiced than your main Quirk: no technique cards of its own; the story plays it from its rules.
Gifted: Extra Limbs.traitNarrativeEffects: Gifted extra Quirk (Extra Limbs family): Scale: born with extra limbs of the player's choice: a second pair of arms, up to about four back or shoulder tentacles, or long prehensile limbs. Each has an adult arm's strength; together they lift about two adults' weight, hands left free. Larger feats need techniques. Limits: blades cut and blows break them, and each is one more thing to grab or pin. They cannot stretch, detach or regrow; grips slip past a few holds at once. Always visible unless covered; strangers stare; clothes and costumes need custom work. Quirk Strain: none for daily use; light: multi-limb strike, bind; moderate: group carry, budded organ, fast climb; heavy: bracing a structure, seizing a group; severe: signature move, splitting limbs among tasks. Type: Mutant. Law: striking, pinning or carrying off a person with the limbs unlicensed is assault or unlawful restraint outside self-defense.

Gifted: Enhanced Senses.name: Gifted: Enhanced Senses
Gifted: Enhanced Senses.description:
🧬 Enhanced Senses, as an extra Quirk put into your body.

🌱 At the start you hear a whisper through a wall, follow a trail hours old or read a face half a kilometer away, and single out a person in a crowd.
📈 With training: early warning of attacks, hidden enemies called out, blind runs through smoke, every buried survivor found, disguises seen through, district-wide tracking.
⚠️ Loud noise always hurts you more.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Sensory Overload, as pushed senses flood the brain.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: Kyoka Jiro (Earphone Jack), Hound Dog (Dog).

⚠️ Less practiced than your main Quirk: no technique cards of its own; the story plays it from its rules.
Gifted: Enhanced Senses.traitNarrativeEffects: Gifted extra Quirk (Enhanced Senses family): Scale: superhuman hearing, smell and/or sight in player-chosen organs. A new adult user hears a whisper through a wall, follows a few-hours-old scent a few kilometers, or reads a face half a kilometer off and sees in near darkness. More needs techniques. Limits: no mind reading: a racing pulse shows stress, not a lie. Sirens, flashes, pepper, smoke and perfume swamp matching senses; rain and vehicles break a trail; soundproofing blocks hearing. Sound attacks always hurt them more; bystanders assume they're overheard. Quirk Strain: everyday sensing free; light: trail, singling someone out; moderate: sensing an attack, calling out hidden foes, blind run; heavy: disaster-site sweep, unmasking disguises; severe: signature read, district-wide hunt. Type: Mutant. Law: spying into homes is a privacy crime; courts treat what they sensed as testimony, not proof.

Gifted: Invisibility.name: Gifted: Invisibility
Gifted: Invisibility.description:
🧬 Invisibility, as an extra Quirk put into your body.

🌱 At the start you bend light around a gloved fist for an unseen blow and slip out of people's notice by standing still.
📈 With training: light flashed into a foe's eyes, every camera in a building mapped, unseen sprints, a person you hold hidden, bonds burned through, a whole group hidden.
⚠️ Clothes and carried things still show, so you must shed them to vanish fully, and you still make noise, leave footprints and have a scent.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Visible Tell, as pushed light flickers your outline into view.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: Toru Hagakure (Invisibility).

⚠️ Less practiced than your main Quirk: no technique cards of its own; the story plays it from its rules.
Gifted: Invisibility.traitNarrativeEffects: Gifted extra Quirk (Invisibility family): Scale: the whole body is permanently invisible (skin, hair, eyes, nails); they see normally and cast no shadow. Clothes and held things stay visible, so full stealth means nothing worn or carried. At first: bending light around a gloved hand for a few seconds. More needs learned techniques. Limits: footsteps, breath, scent and prints in dust or rain give them away; thermal cameras find them. Light tricks fail in darkness; erasure never reveals the body but stops light tricks. People forget the user is there. Quirk Strain: none to be invisible; light: unseen blow, fading from notice; moderate: dazzle, sight-line survey, vanishing sprint; heavy: hiding a held person, burning point; severe: signature burst, hiding a group. Type: Mutant. Law: sneaking into homes or changing rooms is trespass or voyeurism; an unlicensed strike from hiding is assault.

Gifted: Propulsion.name: Gifted: Propulsion
Gifted: Propulsion.description:
🧬 Propulsion, as an extra Quirk put into your body.

🌱 At the start they drive you at about the speed of a car on a city street for about a minute at a time, and kick hard enough to dent a car door.
📈 With training: a ring of foes swept down, the injured shuttled from fires, wall runs, a speeding car beaten to the person in its path, walls rammed, a runaway bus caught.
⚠️ The engines are loud and hot, and they cannot make you fly.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Cooldown, as a pushed engine stalls and must reset.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: Tenya Iida (Engine).

⚠️ Less practiced than your main Quirk: no technique cards of its own; the story plays it from its rules.
Gifted: Propulsion.traitNarrativeEffects: Gifted extra Quirk (Propulsion family): Scale: body engines vent through calf ports, or forearm or back thrusters (player's choice). A new adult user runs at about city-car speed for about a minute before the engines ease off; kicks dent a car door. More needs techniques. Limits: no flying or hovering. Speed makes turns wide and stops long; mud and deep water choke the ports; a blocked port or a firm grip on the limb stalls that engine. Loud, hot engines rule out sneaking while running them. Quirk Strain: none for walking and ordinary running; light: boosted kick, dash; moderate: spinning sweep, rescue shuttle, wall sprint; heavy: last-second save, ram through a wall; severe: signature kick, stopping a runaway vehicle. Type: Mutant. Law: unlicensed engine-speed running on public streets breaks Quirk law; a collision at that speed is also a traffic crime.

Gifted: Regeneration.name: Gifted: Regeneration
Gifted: Regeneration.description:
🧬 Regeneration, as an extra Quirk put into your body.

🌱 At the start you can also force fresh wounds shut mid-fight and take a blow on purpose to land your own.
📈 With training: blades caught barehanded, poison purged, long falls landed, people pulled from fire, others shielded, marches through anything, a lost limb regrown.
⚠️ You feel every wound, and lost limbs do not grow back yet.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Stamina Drain, as healing burns your reserves.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: Super Regeneration.

⚠️ Less practiced than your main Quirk: no technique cards of its own; the story plays it from its rules.
Gifted: Regeneration.traitNarrativeEffects: Gifted extra Quirk (Regeneration family): Scale: fast self-repair. For a new adult user, cuts close in minutes, bruises fade in an hour, broken bones knit in a few hours, all scarless. Faster healing needs techniques. Limits: not instant: a heavy blow still drops the user, pain arrives in full, a fatal wound is still fatal. At the start lost limbs and eyes do not regrow; a blade left in a wound keeps it open; an unset bone knits crooked. Heals only the user. Quirk Strain: none at normal pace; light: taking a blow on purpose; moderate: closing wounds mid-fight, catching a blade, purging a poison, a long fall; heavy: walking through fire, shielding others; severe: signature advance, rebuilding the whole body. Type: Mutant. Law: attackers are still charged for wounds the user healed; unlicensed fighting is still illegal Quirk use.

Gifted: Shadow Manipulation.name: Gifted: Shadow Manipulation
Gifted: Shadow Manipulation.description:
🧬 Shadow Manipulation, as an extra Quirk put into your body.

🌱 Bind a target's ankles in the shadow under them, or step into one shadow and out of another you can see.
📈 Training adds dark glass pins and panes, a coat of dusk, shadow ribbons to lower people, splinters from every shadow in a room and, at the top, a whole city block.
⚠️ It needs real shadow: strong, even light thins it and shadowless light stops it. Your shadow has no mind or voice and does only what you shape.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Activation Condition, as the Quirk works only where real shadow falls.
🎬 Not Fumikage Tokoyami's Dark Shadow, which is a living creature: yours is plain shadow shaped as a material, with no mind of its own.

⚠️ Less practiced than your main Quirk: no technique cards of its own; the story plays it from its rules.
Gifted: Shadow Manipulation.traitNarrativeEffects: Gifted extra Quirk (Shadow Manipulation family): Scale: real shadow shaped as a material. At first, within about ten meters: harmless flat black binding bands; stepping into a shadow at least their size and out of a seen one within about fifteen meters; shapes last about a minute. Dark glass, coats and bigger shapes: learned techniques. Limits: no shadow, no Quirk; strong even light (noon sun, floodlights, flashlights) thins it: shapes fade, binds slip, dark glass goes brittle; firelight makes them unreliable. It has no mind, voice or will and moves only when shaped; darkness means more, never wilder. The user must see it; steps carry only what they wear and hold. Quirk Strain: light: bind, quick step; moderate: glass pin or pane, coat of dusk, lowering people; heavy: glass splinters across a room; severe: signature relay, every shadow on a block. Type: Emitter. Law: unlicensed binding is unlawful confinement; shadow-entering homes or vaults is still trespass or burglary.

Gifted: Vector Lock.name: Gifted: Vector Lock
Gifted: Vector Lock.description:
🧬 Vector Lock, as an extra Quirk put into your body.

🌱 Touch a punch, a swung bat or a thrown object and it stops dead, then goes on its way or turns onto a new line at the same speed.
📈 Training adds locking a runner at a glance, midair pivots, easing falls and crashes to a gentle stop, turning gunfire into the floor and rerouting a whole city block.
⚠️ You never add or store force: a locked thing keeps its own speed, and anything standing still is out of reach.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Sensory Overload, as reading every moving thing at once floods your eyes.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: none close.

⚠️ Less practiced than your main Quirk: no technique cards of its own; the story plays it from its rules.
Gifted: Vector Lock.traitNarrativeEffects: Gifted extra Quirk (Vector Lock family): Scale: the user locks a moving thing's motion so it hangs a moment, then releases it on its old line or a new one, same speed. New adult user, by touch: a punch, swung weapon, thrown object or lunging person, up to motorbike weight at city-street car speed, for a heartbeat or two. Glance, easing and multiple locks need techniques. Limits: motion only (nothing still, parked or a wall); never adds speed or stores force. A locked person still breathes, sees and speaks. Over truck weight or highway speed slides through; unseen, unfelt attacks land. Quirk Strain: light: locking or turning one blow or throw; moderate: glance-locking a runner, midair pivot, easing a fall; heavy: turning gunfire or several chargers; severe: signature stillness, rerouting a block. Type: Emitter. Law: locking a person is use of force; anything turned into a bystander is the user's own Quirk use.

Gifted: Orbit.name: Gifted: Orbit
Gifted: Orbit.description:
🧬 Orbit, as an extra Quirk put into your body.

🌱 Keep a few small objects circling within arm's reach to knock attacks aside, and fling one off its circle as a sling shot.
📈 Training adds a circling cord, a gravel ring, a filming loop, catching falling people, a debris shield and, at the top, every thrown thing pulled into your ring.
⚠️ Objects only circle you and never hang still, and a wall or a body in their path knocks them out of orbit.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Stamina Drain, as every object you keep circling draws on your breath.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: none close.

⚠️ Less practiced than your main Quirk: no technique cards of its own; the story plays it from its rules.
Gifted: Orbit.traitNarrativeEffects: Gifted extra Quirk (Orbit family): Scale: touched-and-released objects circle the user instead of dropping, returning to hand when called. A new adult user keeps up to about five brick-weight objects circling, arm's length to about three meters out, for about a minute; a released one flies straight on at circling speed. Heavier objects, wider rings, people and debris shields need techniques. Limits: orbits center only on the user and move with them; nothing hangs still. A wall, ceiling or body in the path knocks an object down: cramped in corridors, risky in crowds. If the user is knocked out, all fly off along their paths. Any material; weight unchanged. Quirk Strain: light: a few small objects, one sling shot; moderate: circling cord, gravel ring, scouting loop; heavy: catching a falling person, debris shield; severe: signature throw, gathering all thrown at the user. Type: Emitter. Law: a sling shot is a thrown weapon; a lost orbit in a crowd is the user's Quirk use.

Gifted: Density.name: Gifted: Density
Gifted: Density.description:
🧬 Density, as an extra Quirk put into your body.

🌱 Turn heavy in an instant so nothing can shove you, and put your full weight behind a blow.
📈 Training adds drifting down from rooftops, pinning a target, walking a flooded street's bottom, anchoring a sliding car, dropping from the sky and facing a runaway truck.
⚠️ Heavy, you are slow and sink through weak floors; light, a gust carries you off and your blows have no weight. Clothes and gear keep their own weight.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Bodily Toll, as heavy shifts grind your joints and light ones leave you dizzy.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: none close.

⚠️ Less practiced than your main Quirk: no technique cards of its own; the story plays it from its rules.
Gifted: Density.traitNarrativeEffects: Gifted extra Quirk (Density family): Scale: body density shifts in about a second, size and shape kept: at first heavy to about five times their weight (a large motorbike) or light to about a fifth (leaps to a second-floor window, falls several stories unhurt), for about a minute. Car weight, drifting, gliding: learned techniques. Limits: heavy or light, never both or uneven; clothes, gear and anyone carried keep their weight. Heavy: walking pace, no jumps or swims, sinks, breaks wood floors, car roofs; shoves, tackles, blasts and wind cannot budge them; blades, bullets, heat and electricity still hurt. Light: gusts carry them off, blows lack weight, solid hits fling them. Quirk Strain: light: brace, weighted blow; moderate: slow descent, pin, underwater walk; heavy: counterweight, sky drop; severe: signature blow, truck weight. Type: Transformation. Law: unlicensed pinning under their weight is assault; floors or roofs they break are their property damage.

Gifted: Vibration.name: Gifted: Vibration
Gifted: Vibration.description:
🧬 Vibration, as an extra Quirk put into your body.

🌱 Your palm strike rattles a person off their feet, and a palm on the floor reveals footsteps and hollow spaces a room or two away.
📈 Training adds numbing a grip, shaking concrete to rubble, climbing sheer walls, packing rubble over trapped people, quakes through armor and holding a building still.
⚠️ It works only through touch: nothing crosses open air, and mud, water or thick padding swallows it.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Recoil, as every quake you release also shakes your own wrists and elbows.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: Yo Shindo (Vibrate).

⚠️ Less practiced than your main Quirk: no technique cards of its own; the story plays it from its rules.
Gifted: Vibration.traitNarrativeEffects: Gifted extra Quirk (Vibration family): Scale: the user vibrates what they touch, faint hum to violent shake, and feels vibration via hands and feet. New adult user: a palm strike knocks an adult down and cracks paving stone or cinderblock; a palm on floor or wall feels footsteps, drops and hollows through about two rooms or one floor. Bigger feats need techniques. Limits: contact only, via solid joined material, never air; soft soil, mud, water, loose sand and padding absorb it. No sensing the perfectly still, fliers or swimmers; engines and machinery drown it. Shaking a load-bearing wall apart can drop a floor. Quirk Strain: light: strike, reading; moderate: numbing grip, shattered wall, climb; heavy: packing rubble, quake through armor; severe: signature move, holding a building still. Type: Emitter. Law: unlicensed wall or pavement shattering: property damage; a quake cracking a structure near bystanders: reckless endangerment.

Gifted: Psychometry.name: Gifted: Psychometry
Gifted: Psychometry.description:
🧬 Psychometry, as an extra Quirk put into your body.

🌱 A touch reaches back only a few minutes, and in a fight, touching an opponent's weapon shows you where it was about to go.
📈 Training adds tracing a stolen object through every hand, disarming a grip you have read, seeing a collapse, following guards' worn paths and reading a scene days back.
⚠️ You read objects and places, never living minds, and gloves or fire stop you cold.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Sensory Overload, as other people's strongest moments crash into you with every touch.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: none close.

⚠️ Less practiced than your main Quirk: no technique cards of its own; the story plays it from its rules.
Gifted: Psychometry.traitNarrativeEffects: Gifted extra Quirk (Psychometry family): Scale: bare fingertips on an object or spot read its residue: at first the last few minutes within a few strides (who touched it, their faces and hands, what they did and felt, words said in strong feeling). In a fight, touching a foe's weapon shows where it was about to go. Hours and days need learned techniques. Limits: objects and places only, never living minds or bodies. Gloves block it; crowd-handled things (cash, railings, straps) blur; fire scours residue. Fresh, strong feelings drown older, calm ones; impressions are images and feelings to interpret, so can mislead. Quirk Strain: light: quick reading, read parry; moderate: chain of hands, disarm, worn path; heavy: a collapse or battleground; severe: signature move, full scene. Type: Emitter. Law: reading private belongings without consent or a warrant is invasion of privacy; readings are police leads, never court evidence alone.

Gifted: Machine Whisper.name: Gifted: Machine Whisper
Gifted: Machine Whisper.description:
🧬 Machine Whisper, as an extra Quirk put into your body.

🌱 A touch tells you what is running, what is broken and how to work it; you open an electronic lock, close a shutter or stall an engine with no key or code.
📈 Training adds locking villains in their own gear, lurching a forklift at an attacker, steadying an elevator, distant drones and driverless cars, and a whole building.
⚠️ Only machines with a motor, an engine or a circuit answer: a padlock, a knife, a gun and anything living are out of reach.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Cognitive Fade, as every machine you hold crowds your own thoughts until words come slowly.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: none close.

⚠️ Less practiced than your main Quirk: no technique cards of its own; the story plays it from its rules.
Gifted: Machine Whisper.traitNarrativeEffects: Gifted extra Quirk (Machine Whisper family): Scale: bare-skin touch reads a machine's state, faults and design and makes it run any built-in function without controls, key or code. New adult user: one touched machine at a time (car, lock, phone, drone); distance needs techniques. Limits: only motor, engine or circuit machines; never simple mechanisms (padlocks, knives, guns, bicycles) or living things, Quirk-made limbs included; implants (pacemaker, prosthetic) are beyond a new user. Only what working parts allow: no power, no motion; cut cables stay cut. No electricity, no metal pulling; many machines at once blur. Quirk Strain: light: reading, unlock, stall; moderate: locking gear, lurch, drone steering; heavy: halting a failing machine, remote driving; severe: signature, running a building. Type: Emitter. Law: unlocking or taking a vehicle without consent or license is unauthorized access and theft; police check registered machine Quirks first after a hacked door.

Gifted: Afterimage.name: Gifted: Afterimage
Gifted: Afterimage.description:
🧬 Afterimage, as an extra Quirk put into your body.

🌱 Leave a standing image of yourself behind, fake a lunge with an image of your body, or replay what you witnessed at life size a few strides away.
📈 Training adds a blinding stored glare, replays that show police what you saw, a false wall across an alley, a lit way out of smoke and a street full of your images.
⚠️ Your images are light only: no weight, no sound, no shadow, and anything that touches them passes straight through.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Visible Tell, as your eyes glow with whatever you have stored and give away a coming projection.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: none close.

⚠️ Less practiced than your main Quirk: no technique cards of its own; the story plays it from its rules.
Gifted: Afterimage.traitNarrativeEffects: Gifted extra Quirk (Afterimage family): Scale: the eyes store sight, projected as moving, full-color light. A new adult user keeps about the last ten minutes (rolling, unless a moment is kept) and projects any stored moment life-size anywhere visible within about ten meters, or their own figure, posed and moving at will; other images only replay sight, as seen. Larger, longer ones need techniques. Limits: light only: no weight, sound, touch, heat or shadow; things pass through. Solid by day; a glow betrays them in the dark. Fades if the user loses sight or focus; no unseen faces or places. Cameras record them. No beams, burning or hiding the user's body. Quirk Strain: light: standing image, feint; moderate: glare, replay, false wall; heavy: lit route, crowd of selves; severe: signature, projected battalion. Type: Emitter. Law: deceiving police or public is obstruction and fraud; showing real heroes or officers unlicensed is impersonation; a replay is sworn testimony, not a recording.

Gifted: Anchor Point.name: Gifted: Anchor Point
Gifted: Anchor Point.description:
🧬 Anchor Point, as an extra Quirk put into your body.

🌱 Hold up to three anchors, always sensing each, and snap to any within your city district, arriving at rest whatever your speed, so a snap ends a fall.
📈 Training adds strike-and-snap, sending a touched person to safety, delivering a villain to a police van, tagging a car, shuttling people from fires and up to six anchors.
⚠️ Only you and what you wear and carry make the trip: a grip on you is left holding air, and an anchor someone stands on puts you down beside them.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Sensory Overload, as each snap leaves you dizzy and half-deaf for a breath.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: none close.

⚠️ Less practiced than your main Quirk: no technique cards of its own; the story plays it from its rules.
Gifted: Anchor Point.traitNarrativeEffects: Gifted extra Quirk (Anchor Point family): Scale: a bare palm held a moment on a fixed spot plants an anchor. New adult user: up to three, each lasting about a day, always sensing direction and distance; focus snaps them to any anchor within about 2 km, arriving at rest, so a snap ends a fall. Carrying or sending others, moving or extra anchors need techniques. Limits: only body and gear go; grippers hold air; a chained rope or cuff stays, wrenching the wrist. Anchors: non-living fixed spots only, lost if moved. Occupied: arrive beside them; sealed, flooded or buried: snap fails. No snap unconscious or panicking. Quirk Strain: light: snap, strike-and-recall; moderate: send or carry one, tag a vehicle; heavy: shuttle several, three-sided rush; severe: signature throw, six anchors. Type: Emitter. Law: snapping into a locked home or office is trespass; warrantless anchoring of a stranger's car to tail it is stalking.

Gifted: Glass.name: Gifted: Glass
Gifted: Glass.description:
🧬 Glass, as an extra Quirk put into your body.

🌱 Raise a door-sized pane, flick blunt beads, grow lenses, shards and plates. Your glass stops fists and pistol rounds until a blow hits its weak point.
📈 Training adds shackles fused to the floor, a lens that focuses sunlight, glazing shut a cracking wall, stairs up a building, shard fans and holding up a falling tower.
⚠️ You always feel the weak point and can shift it, but sudden heat change cracks it.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Bodily Toll, as the skin at your knuckles cracks and bleeds when you push it.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: none close.

⚠️ Less practiced than your main Quirk: no technique cards of its own; the story plays it from its rules.
Gifted: Glass.traitNarrativeEffects: Gifted extra Quirk (Glass family): Scale: clear glass wells from palms and forearms and sets hard in a second or two as guided; at first about a bucket per scene, up to a door-sized pane. It stops fists, bats, knives and pistol rounds, but a blow on its weak point shatters it; the user feels that point and all strain and can shift it by touch. Bigger structures need learned techniques. Limits: only self-grown glass obeys, though they feel strain in any glass touched. It hides nothing; sudden heat change (fire, then water) cracks it; shards cut unless carefully grown to break blunt. Quirk Strain: light: pane, beads; moderate: shackle, lens, stair; heavy: glazing a failing structure, shard fan; severe: signature fist, holding up a building. Type: Emitter (also fits Mutant). Law: glass left on roads is the user's to clear; unlicensed shards count as weapons.

Gifted: Living Ink.name: Gifted: Living Ink
Gifted: Living Ink.description:
🧬 Living Ink, as an extra Quirk put into your body.

🌱 Sketch a rope that hauls a person up or a hound that knocks a target down. A quick sketch is flimsy; a careful one holds an adult or stops a punch.
📈 Training adds drawn nets, scout birds that come back as a sketch of what they saw, ladders, shields, a whole pack at once and a mural that keeps working without you.
⚠️ Constructs fade after a few minutes and dissolve in water, so rain, a hose or a sprinkler ends them.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Finite Fuel, as your body makes ink slowly and a long fight leaves your fingertips dry.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: none close.

⚠️ Less practiced than your main Quirk: no technique cards of its own; the story plays it from its rules.
Gifted: Living Ink.traitNarrativeEffects: Gifted extra Quirk (Living Ink family): Scale: the user's fingertips draw black ink on any dry surface; simple drawings lift off as solid constructs up to large-dog or door size, obeying spoken orders in sight. New adult user: up to three; a quick sketch (seconds) breaks under a solid blow; a careful one (a full turn) holds an adult's weight, pulls a person, stops a punch, bites hard. More, bigger or self-acting constructs need techniques. Limits: constructs fade in about five minutes and dissolve at once in any water, even a crossed puddle; simple orders only, no speech, no copied look or power. Needs a free hand and a surface; ink refills slowly, so long fights run dry. Quirk Strain: light: rope, hound; moderate: net, scout bird, ladder; heavy: shield, pack; severe: signature beast, working mural. Type: Emitter. Law: unpermitted drawing on public walls is vandalism even if the ink fades; a construct's bite is the user's own assault.

Gifted: Undo.name: Gifted: Undo
Gifted: Undo.description:
🧬 Undo, as an extra Quirk put into your body.

🌱 A shattered window stands whole, a bent bar straightens, a spilled bag repacks, and scattered pieces fly back, striking whatever stands in the way.
📈 Training adds closing a breach around a villain, making an armed bomb safe, raising a fallen stair, undoing a crushed car around its riders, rebuilding part of a house.
⚠️ Living bodies are out of reach: wounds, ages and Quirks never answer, and a body in the way stops the returning pieces.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Cognitive Fade, as holding the earlier shape of things in mind blurs your own last few minutes.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: Eri (Rewind), which works on living bodies; this one cannot.

⚠️ Less practiced than your main Quirk: no technique cards of its own; the story plays it from its rules.
Gifted: Undo.traitNarrativeEffects: Gifted extra Quirk (Undo family): Scale: by touch the user restores a non-living object's shape, wholeness and contents from any moment in the last minute. A new adult user undoes up to door or motorbike size. The object stays put; its broken or fallen pieces from that span fly back, bruising anyone between. Touch also senses whether and how it changed. Longer spans, larger objects need techniques. Limits: no living bodies, the user's included (wounds, age, illness, Quirks); clothing only once removed. Returning pieces press around a living body without crushing. Used-up things never return (burned fuel, eaten food, fired shots); older changes are final. Quirk Strain: light: mend, recall; moderate: closed breach, defused device, raised stair; heavy: crushed vehicle, rubble recall; severe: signature reset, rebuilding a house. Type: Emitter. Law: undoing crime-scene evidence is tampering; police suspect a registered Undo user near a tidied scene until cleared.

Gifted: Precognition.name: Gifted: Precognition
Gifted: Precognition.description:
🧬 Precognition, as an extra Quirk put into your body.

🌱 At the start you see about three seconds of whatever your own eyes would see, so you dodge, counter and shout warnings a beat early.
📈 Training adds grabbing a runner where they are about to step, crossing a collapsing street untouched, knocking a weapon loose before it fires, a ten-second horizon and, at your peak, a minute ahead.
⚠️ A blow from behind or through a wall never shows, a big brawl blurs into noise, and acting on a glimpse changes it.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Sensory Overload, as a crowded fight floods you with seconds that have not happened yet.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: none close; Sir Nighteye's Foresight reads hours of one person's life instead.

⚠️ Less practiced than your main Quirk: no technique cards of its own; the story plays it from its rules.
Gifted: Precognition.traitNarrativeEffects: Gifted extra Quirk (Precognition family): Scale: awake and focused, a new adult user glimpses about three seconds ahead of all in their line of sight (punches, a runner's turn, a falling sign, a swerving car) as a motion overlay, so they move, counter and warn early. Longer windows, whole streets and others' safety need techniques. Limits: only what their own eyes would see; nothing behind, through walls or out of sight shows. It shows events' course if unchanged; acting on it branches events; they see anew. Motion and events only, never thoughts, plans or words; crowded fast brawls blur to noise. Asleep, blindfolded or in total darkness: nothing. Quirk Strain: light: dodge, counter, warning; moderate: pinned grab, run through danger, disarm; heavy: ten-second horizon over a block; severe: signature move, a minute ahead. Type: Emitter. Law: legal in self-defense and licensed duty; cheating at gambling or sports with it is fraud.

Gifted: Prognostication.name: Gifted: Prognostication
Gifted: Prognostication.description:
🧬 Prognostication, as an extra Quirk put into your body.

🌱 At the start a reading shows about fifteen minutes of that person's future, once per person per day.
📈 Training adds throwing at where a read opponent will be, pulling someone out of a coming accident, having police waiting where a suspect will go, a full hour, several people at once and, at your peak, a whole day ahead.
⚠️ No touch or no eye contact, no reading; it never shows thoughts, and acting on a vision changes the future it showed.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Cognitive Fade, as a long reading leaves your own day blurry.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: Sir Nighteye's Foresight.

⚠️ Less practiced than your main Quirk: no technique cards of its own; the story plays it from its rules.
Gifted: Prognostication.traitNarrativeEffects: Gifted extra Quirk (Prognostication family): Scale: touch (skin or clothing) plus eye contact shows the user in a breath a person's next stretch as rapid scenes from beside them: where they go, whom they meet, what they say and do, what befalls them. At first about fifteen minutes ahead, once per person per day; longer, multi-person and combat readings: learned techniques. Limits: sunglasses, eye masks or shut eyes block it; the narrator never opens a refuser's eyes. It shows the course if nobody acts, never fate; acting branches it, the player stays free. Only events to and around them: never thoughts, memories or secrets they would not reveal then, nor the user's future except beside them. Quirk Strain: light: short reading, foreseen throw; moderate: saved accident, set trap, route reading; heavy: several people; severe: signature move, a full day. Type: Emitter. Law: a reading is a lead, never court evidence alone; stalking, blackmail or robbery by it is a crime.

Gifted: Encore.name: Gifted: Encore
Gifted: Encore.description:
🧬 Encore, as an extra Quirk put into your body.

🌱 Start within six meters: steady allies, upset an opponent's step, supply music and a soft spotlight, and physically repeat a simple move with "Encore".
📈 Attention stores power. Training adds capture footwork, leaps, crowd evacuation and stronger audience flourishes; replays never reverse time or copy another Quirk.
⚠️ Silence, being ignored and noise that buries your beat weaken you. Common drawback pairing: Stamina Drain, from performing and repeating moves.
⚖️ Venues may require permission; forced movement needs self-defense or licensed duty. Nobody must sing, dance or follow orders.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: Present Mic (Voice), for vocal delivery only.

⚠️ Less practiced than your main Quirk: no technique cards of its own; the story plays it from its rules.
Gifted: Encore.traitNarrativeEffects: Gifted extra Quirk (Encore family): Scale: sound organs give rhythmic pressure, tones, a soft glow. New adult user, six meters: steadies two willing allies or unbalances a listener's step; "Encore" re-performs a simple move bodily; training widens it. Limits: bodies only, not minds or Quirk activation; nobody must sing or dance; no free sound or solid light. Earplugs, soundproofing, silence or louder noise stop it. Charges: +1 per turn with an attentive live observer (any side) in hearing, max 3; crowds, recordings, being ignored: none; a broken beat clears all; never replaces stamina. Replays undo, restore and copy nothing. Quirk Strain: light: opening beat; moderate: reprise, capture footwork, palm strike, leap; heavy: evacuation, audience flourish; severe: signature formation, company rhythm, awakened performances; reprises: double exertion. Type: Emitter. Law: venue permits where required; forced movement or restraint outside self-defense or licensed duty is assault.

Gifted: Adaptation.name: Gifted: Adaptation
Gifted: Adaptation.description:
🧬 Adaptation, as an extra Quirk put into your body.

🌱 At the start the first blow, burn or breath of gas lands normally; by your next turn your body grows one answer to it: a layered hide that halves those hits, or gill slits and filtering lungs that breathe water, smoke or gas.
📈 With training: hold two adaptations (three at mastery), eyes and ears that adapt to dark, smoke and din, grip pads and webbing for walls, falls and floods, carrying people through fire or flood, clinches a foe can't break, and calling up a trained adaptation from memory.
⏳ Adaptations fade about ten minutes after the danger ends, and a new threat replaces the oldest one. Training one many times makes it come faster and stronger, never permanent.
⚠️ Fast attacks land before it forms, it never copies or resists Quirks themselves or heals wounds fast, and under heavy Strain your body overcorrects into the wrong change.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Loss of Control, because your body picks its own changes.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: none close.

⚠️ Less practiced than your main Quirk: no technique cards of its own; the story plays it from its rules.
Gifted: Adaptation.traitNarrativeEffects: Gifted extra Quirk (Adaptation family): Scale: threats and hazards reshape the body unbidden: hide, gills, fire- or shock-proof skin, filter lungs, night pupils, cold fat, slow blood, grip pads. The first hit, burn or breath lands; the change forms by next turn's end. Holds one (trained two, master three), newest replacing oldest; fades ten minutes after danger; training: faster, stronger, never permanent. Limits: the body picks; fast attacks beat it; never on command unexposed; physical only: no Quirk copying or resisting, fast healing, chosen animal parts; aids others only indirectly (shield, carry, breathe for them). Quirk Strain: light: reactive hide, lung shift; moderate: adapted senses, self-exposure, terrain shifts; heavy: hazard rescue, clinch; severe: signature surge, memory recall; heavy Strain overcorrects (wrong trait, stiff growths). Type: Transformation. Law: involuntary adaptation is lawful; public provoking, or unlicensed striking or pinning with it, is assault.

Gifted: Arm Cannon.name: Gifted: Arm Cannon
Gifted: Arm Cannon.description:
🧬 Arm Cannon, as an extra Quirk put into your body.

🌱 At the start you fire quick calcium rounds, or hold a glowing, whining charge that knocks an adult down from across a street.
📈 With training: door breaching, recoil jumps and fall braking, rescue ropes and grapple lines, blunt stun rounds, signal flares, a street-wide salvo.
⚠️ The cannon is useless for fine work until it turns back into a hand.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Recoil, as stronger shots jar your shoulder and throw you backward.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: none close.

⚠️ Less practiced than your main Quirk: no technique cards of its own; the story plays it from its rules.
Gifted: Arm Cannon.traitNarrativeEffects: Gifted extra Quirk (Arm Cannon family): Scale: one forearm (side fixed at creation) becomes a heavy bone-and-muscle cannon. A new adult user fires reserve-made calcium rounds about twenty meters, or a few-second charge that drops an adult across a street; special rounds and reach need training. Limits: no grip or fine work; reverting takes about three seconds. Straight shots can hit people beyond. Ropes, grapples, harnesses are carried gear. Quirk Strain: light: snap shot, flare; moderate: basic charge, rope launch, recoil jump, blunt round; heavy: breaching shot; severe: signature, sustained battery, awakened techniques. Type: Transformation (also fits Mutant). Law: outside self-defense or licensed duty, shooting people is assault, breaching property damage; strays are on the user.

Single Quirk.name: Single Quirk
Single Quirk.description:
🧬 One Quirk, the one you chose above.

🌱 The usual case: most people inherit one Quirk, sometimes a mix of a parent's, sometimes something new.
Single Quirk.traitNarrativeEffects: The character has a single Quirk.

All For One's Gift.name: All For One's Gift
All For One's Gift.description:
💀 Someone put more Quirks into your body: All For One, or a broker working with his machines. You chose one or two extra Quirks in the next step.

⚠️ Every extra Quirk is a separate weight on your body. Use them one at a time and it holds; use them together and Quirk Strain climbs fast.
⚠️ It shows: doctors and the police can tell something is wrong with you.
🎬 Similar canon: Nomu, Tomura Shigaraki, the League's Quirk-boosted fighters.

📈 Grants: one or two extra Quirks (next step)
All For One's Gift.traitNarrativeEffects: The character carries extra Quirks forced into the body (All For One's gift or a broker's machine), each a separate Quirk with its own Gifted trait. Using ONE Quirk costs Quirk Strain as usual. Using two Quirks in the same action costs both and +10 more; three at once costs all three and +25 more. Holding two or more Quirks active at the same time adds +5 Strain every turn they stay on. From 60 Strain the body shows it (nosebleeds, migraines, hairline cracks in the skin); from 75 the extra Quirks misfire or answer late; at 100 one of them tears free of control or the body breaks, a serious injury. Rest clears Strain as usual; nothing heals the strain itself. Erasure stops every one of them. A scan, a Quirk test or Recovery Girl finds the anomaly at once: unregistered extra Quirks are a crime in themselves and a lead to All For One.

Self-Made Vigilante.name: Self-Made Vigilante
Self-Made Vigilante.description:
🌙 You took to the streets on your own: no license, no record, nobody's permission.

📈 Grants: Streetwise +5, Stealth +5
Self-Made Vigilante.traitNarrativeEffects: The character became a vigilante without a criminal past: no record, no license, no file with the police except rumors of a masked helper.

Reformed Villain.name: Reformed Villain
Reformed Villain.description:
🔁 You were a villain once, and you walked away. Now you help people without a license, with a record that follows you.

⚠️ The police have your file; some old contacts want you back, some want you gone.
📈 Grants: Streetwise +5, Intimidation +5
Reformed Villain.traitNarrativeEffects: The character is a former villain who turned to vigilante work: a criminal record (served time, or never caught for most of it), old underworld contacts who know their face and want them back or silenced, and police and pros who assume the worst at first sight. Doing good does not erase the past; trust is earned on the page. If they were ever given extra Quirks, this is where they came from.

Tartarus Escapee.name: Tartarus Escapee
Tartarus Escapee.description:
⛓️ You broke out of Tartarus, or out of a prison like it, and now you fight on the side you never chose before.

⚠️ You are wanted: your face is on file and a recapture team would love to find you.
📈 Grants: Survival +5, Stealth +5
Tartarus Escapee.traitNarrativeEffects: The character escaped from Tartarus or another prison and works as a vigilante while wanted: their photo is on police files and wanted lists, recapture is always one sighting away, and anyone who recognizes them must decide whether to call it in. Before the Tartarus breakout after the war they escaped alone; afterward, among hundreds. Doing good does not lift the warrant.
